programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: Transat Jacques Vabre 2023 - Summary 1
programme.desc: First summary of the Transat Jacques Vabre 2023 with a start disrupted by very difficult weather and the first arrivals in the Ultim class.

programme.title: Lords Of Tram GKA Big Air Kite World Cup France 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The second stop of the GKA Big Air 2025 season happened at Lords of Tram in the legendary spot of Barcarès, France, powered by the epic Tramontana winds that sweep down off the snow-capped Pyrenees. Reigning Big Air Twin-tip World Champions, Spain’s Jeremy Burlando and the Netherlands’ Zara Hoogenraad, will be on hand to defend their titles.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: Transat Jacques Vabre 2023 - Summary 2 Eng
programme.desc: Second summary of the Transat Jacques Vabre 2023 with the race and the finish of the Ocean Fifty, Imoca and Class 40 categories.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2025 - Episode 10
programme.desc: We start this episode with the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup. We then travel to Finland. The 8 Metre Class World Cup 2025 unfolded in Turku. The week-long competition would see 21 yachts from eight nations battling in the waters of Airisto. We are now heading to Turkey, where The Çanakkale Leg of the 6th International Presidential Yacht Races took place in Istanbul. We then move to China for the 2025 WingFoil Racing World Cup China, with 70 competitors from around the world battling it out. We also enjoy even more foiling action. Austria’s sparkling jewel, Lake Traunsee, became the epicentre of the grand finale for the 2025 SFT Surf Foil World Tour Pump Foil discipline, where history would be made and the first-ever pump foil world champions were crowned.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2025 - Episode 9
programme.desc: We start this episode from Portugal for the 29er Porto World Sailing Championship 2025. We then travel to Finland. The 8 Metre Class World Cup 2025 unfolded in Turku. The week-long competition would see 21 yachts from eight nations battling in the waters of Airisto. Later on, we shift our focus on Greece for the 24th edition of the Aegean Regatta. We also visit Dodecanese for the Rodos Cup 2025. Moreover, we take look of foiling with the WASZP Games in Weymouth in the UK. 248 boats from 20 countries gathered in one of the world’s most iconic foiling venues. Lastly, we will highlight another foiling discipline : the Audi 2025 WingFoil Racing World Cup Türkiye which took place against the stunning backdrop of the Bosphorus.

programme.title: Freestyle Pro Tour 2025 Naxos Greece
programme.desc: The Freestyle Pro Tour is more than excited to return to the island of Naxos. Once again, the tour is gathering on the beach in front of Sun Kyma, where the last year’s event with a full fleet of 50 riders and unforgettable vibes on and off the water. The wind is strong with up to 35 knots on big days. Strong north winds mean side on shore conditions, which give the spot its bump and jump Character.

programme.title: Ensis ENGADINWING WingFoil Racing World Cup Switzerland 2025
programme.desc: The world’s most daring wingfoilers are heading for the heights—literally—as the Ensis ENGADINWING 2025 WingFoil Racing World Cup Switzerland descends on lake Silvaplana. Nestling in the Swiss Alps, Lake Silvaplana offers both breathtaking scenery and a notoriously unpredictable wind pattern that will test even the most seasoned racers.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Gran Canaria 2025
programme.desc: The world’s best wingfoilers compete on the Spanish island of Gran Canaria for the Surf-Freestyle world champion title. A full roster of 28 men, accompanied by 14 women, from 12 nations around the world, are set to battle it out at Playa El Burrero, the third successive year that Gran Canaria has hosted a GWA World Cup.

programme.title: Copa Kitley GKA Big Air World Cup 2024 Brazil
programme.desc: The Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour is set to electrify the shores of Jericoacoara, Brazil, with high-stakes competition in its three big air divisions - TwinTip, Hydrofoil and Surfboard. Making its debut at this iconic Brazilian kiteboarding spot, a total of 57 athletes compete for world titles in the Surfboard and Hydrofoil disciplines, while the TwinTip division host a normal World Cup event.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2025 3
programme.desc: Cette 3e et avant dernière étape servait de répétition du grand final de demain où, si la météo le permet, la course franchira le col de la Forclaz. Ce col situé au pied du Grand Mont est le théâtre d’une communion, sans égale depuis39 ans, entre les coureurs et les milliers de spectateurs massés à 2.374 m.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: Aussie 8
programme.desc: Aussie 8 is the adventure of 3 friends who decided to climb the 8 tallest mountains in 8 Australian states in 8 days. To make this possible, they had to put together and respect a very strict timing and logistic organisation.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Monte Croce Dolomites Winter Hike
programme.desc: Wonderful winter day hike to a WWI bunker and then up to see Yaks - winter furry cows and then to a refuge while enjoying the views of the Dolomites.Magnifique randonnée dune journée dhiver jusquà un bunker de la Première Guerre mondiale, puis jusquà voir des yaks - des vaches à fourrure dhiver, puis jusquà un refuge tout en profitant de la vue sur les Dolomites.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2025 4
programme.desc: Axelle Gachet-Mollaret et Lorna Bonnel remportent cette 39e édition de la Pierra Menta avec classe. Chez les hommes, Xavier Gachet etWilliam Bon Mardion simposent et réalisent un doublé historique 10 jours après leur titre de champion du monde par équipe

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2025 2
programme.desc: Les coureurs ont pu profiter de la ferveur populaire des habitants du village d’Arêches, au départ de cette2e étape, pour faire le plein d’énergie. Cette communion avec le public beaufortain faisait figure de prologue à une étape décrite par les participants comme la plus difficile vécue avec ses 5 cols, 31 km, 3350 m de D+ et 3165 m deD-. Les chutes de neige de la nuit encore actives le matin ont largement contribué à alourdir l’effort malgré un énorme travail des bénévoles pour entretenir la trace.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata In The Dolomites Climbing Possnecker Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2025 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.desc: Relive all the action from Supertri Jersey – where the world’s best triathletes went head-to-head in one of the most thrilling stops of the season. From explosive swims to lightning-fast transitions and epic sprints to the finish line, these highlights capture the intensity, drama, and excitement that define Supertri.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealand’s nine Great Walks faster than they’ve ever been done before, using human power alone. It’s the ultimate adventure race. They’ll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: Spartan Super World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: High in Californias Sierra Nevada, the world gathers for a new test of endurance. This is the Spartan Super World Championship 2025, hosted by Mammoth Lakes, California. A race that starts at 2,400 metres above sea level and climbs higher still. Every athlete knows what waits ahead. 11 kilometres, 26 obstacles and the full force of the mountain.

programme.title: The Outdoor Sports Show 2025 - Episode 10
programme.desc: We start this episode in Romania with the Brasov Running Festival. Then we move to the streets of Chicago for the Bank of America Chicago Marathon. We then embark on a multi-day hiking adventure through the breathtaking peaks and valleys of Velebit, Croatia, where the HIGHLANDER Velebit takes place every autumn. We then travel to Cuba for the OCEANMAN CUBA. We are also visiting Great Britain for an Equestrian event : the Agria FEI Evening European Championship for Seniors. Moreover, we are adding a new discipline to our TV Show. Anticipation was huge ahead of the start of the WBSC U-18 Baseball World Cup 2025 in the Okinawa Prefecture in Japan. Finally, we finish off our episode with some the 2025 Wrestling World Championships in Zagreb, Croatia.

programme.title: Spartan Trifecta World Championship 2025 Eng
programme.desc: This year the Trifecta World Championship arrives in the United States for the very first time. Representing 28 nations united by the pursuit of challenge, honour and glory. Three days, three races and one journey that pushes the body and mind to their very limits. The sprint, 5 kilometers and 20 obstacles, the super 10 kilometers and 25 obstacles, and the beast, 21 kilometers and 30 obstacles.

programme.title: Nadelhorn Via Normal Route - The Best Alpine Experience Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv are hiking to the summit of Nadelhorn (4,327 m), which lies in the Mischabel group in Switzerland. We follow their adventure from the village of Saas-Fee to the Mischabel Hut, a mountain hut that lies at an elevation of 3,340 meters and that has beautiful views of Lenzspitze, Dom, Nadelhorn, Weissmies, and many other 4000-meter peaks. And finally after having crossed the Hohbalmgletscher, they go over the North-East ridge to get to the summit of Nadelhorn which offers superb views of the Alps and their summits such as the Weisshorn and the famous Matterhorn.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealand’s nine Great Walks faster than they’ve ever been done before, using human power alone. It’s the ultimate adventure race. They’ll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.title: Supertri 2025 Rd 2 Chicago Eng
programme.desc: Next generation talent, dominating wins and all change in the Teams League; Supertri League Chicago was an unpredictable affair.

programme.title: 2025 WES UCI E-MTB XC World Cup Massa Marittima Italy Eng
programme.desc: Welcome to WES World E-Bike Series Round 7 of the UCI E-MTB World Cup, for the Season Finale in Massa Marittima, Italy. “Massa Marittima Trail Area” is nestled in the heart of this hill, with over 180 kilometresof trails, maintained with dedication throughout the year, where a brand-new racecourse was created to host the E-MTB World Cup and become a permanent facility, within the spectacular resort named “Tenuta il Cicalino”.

programme.title: L Eroica 2025
programme.desc: LEroica draws its inspiration from classical cycling, from black and white images published on newspapers of the early 1900s to the times of the Bartali and Coppi duel, to more recent times when pedal cages and shifters on the down tube where still the main option on road racing bikes. LEroica chose as a convention 1987 as the year to draw the line between classic cycling and modern times.

programme.title: 2025 WES UCI E-MTB XC World Cup Olbia Sardinia Italy Eng
programme.desc: The round, presented by the Autonomous Region of Sardinia and the City of Olbia, is in Monte Pino, a mountainous area near Olbia, in northeastern Sardinia, Italy. It offers panoramic views of the Gallura landscape, lush Mediterranean vegetation, and winding roads popular for hiking, cycling, and driving. The area is also a favorite spot for MTB racing, with trails, natural obstacles, and varied terrain that attract both local riders and visitors.

programme.title: Nightmare Climbs - Crostis Eng
programme.desc: A nightmare climb up Crostis mountain in Carnia which is part of Friuli venezia Giulia in northern Italy. Patrick and Emiliano will ride up 14.5 km with 1374 meters of climb and an average steepness of 9.5 ........you will be out of breath....

programme.title: Arctic Race of Norway 2025
programme.desc: The Arctic Race of Norway (ARN) is a four-day road race held every year in August in Northern Norway’s magnificent scenery. Created in 2013, the event has continuously developed and is now established as Scandinavia’s main international cycling event, and one of Norway’s most important sports events. Thanks to its high level of organizational, media and sporting performance, the event is part of the UCI ProSeries, the second highest division of cycling races. Each year, several Tour de France teams and some of the world’s greatest cycling stars participate in the ARN and fight for the race’s iconic prizes. One of the event’s fundamental values is to federate across geographical and political barriers. The ARN is a free, accessible and inclusive event. It does not require any important infrastructure or facility but uses the most beautiful stadium in the world: the stunning roads of Northern Norway.

programme.title: Deutschland Tour 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to highlights of the Lidl Deutschland Tour, in its 40th Anniversary Edition, a race that goes all the way back to 1911. But it had a recent revival after a ten year hiatus. This is the seventh year of the event being run by ASO, the organisers of the Tour de France, the Vuelta Espana, of course, amongst other races.

programme.title: Czech Tour 2025
programme.desc: This years Czech Tour stage race marks the biggest change in the sixteen-year history of the Czech Republic‘s most important cycling event. The peloton starts in Prague for the first time, then visit Karlovy Vary and Pardubice, from where it heads to traditional locations in the Jeseníky and Beskydy Mountains. Teams from the elite World Tour category once again line up at the start, with, among others, the Visma-Lease a Bike and Soudal Quick-Step teams.

programme.title: Tour of Hellas 2025 - Full Summary
programme.desc: The 2025 Tour of Hellas consists of 5 days of action across 3 Regions and a total distance of 811.19 km. From Patras to an impressive end at Syntagma Square, The Tour of Hellas connects western and central Greece with Attica. 20 teams are particpating, among them World Tour teams Jayco AlUla and XDS Astana.

programme.title: 2025 WES UCI E-MTB XC World Cup Season Review Road to victory Eng
programme.desc: Welcome to WES 2025 Season Review, an opportunity to re-live the exciting action of the recently ended season and get to know a bit more about the protagonists of this incredible year of racing.

programme.title: L Eroica 2025
programme.desc: LEroica draws its inspiration from classical cycling, from black and white images published on newspapers of the early 1900s to the times of the Bartali and Coppi duel, to more recent times when pedal cages and shifters on the down tube where still the main option on road racing bikes. LEroica chose as a convention 1987 as the year to draw the line between classic cycling and modern times.

programme.title: Copa Kitley GKA Big Air World Cup 2024 Brazil
programme.desc: The Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour is set to electrify the shores of Jericoacoara, Brazil, with high-stakes competition in its three big air divisions - TwinTip, Hydrofoil and Surfboard. Making its debut at this iconic Brazilian kiteboarding spot, a total of 57 athletes compete for world titles in the Surfboard and Hydrofoil disciplines, while the TwinTip division host a normal World Cup event.

programme.title: Ensis ENGADINWING WingFoil Racing World Cup Switzerland 2025
programme.desc: The world’s most daring wingfoilers are heading for the heights—literally—as the Ensis ENGADINWING 2025 WingFoil Racing World Cup Switzerland descends on lake Silvaplana. Nestling in the Swiss Alps, Lake Silvaplana offers both breathtaking scenery and a notoriously unpredictable wind pattern that will test even the most seasoned racers.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Gran Canaria 2025
programme.desc: The world’s best wingfoilers compete on the Spanish island of Gran Canaria for the Surf-Freestyle world champion title. A full roster of 28 men, accompanied by 14 women, from 12 nations around the world, are set to battle it out at Playa El Burrero, the third successive year that Gran Canaria has hosted a GWA World Cup.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: Defender GKA Kite-Surf World Cup 2025
programme.desc: The GKA Kite World Tour returns to the legendary shores of Sylt in 2025 for an adrenaline-fueled spectacle—the Kite-Surf & Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup! Witness the world’s best riders defy gravity, push limits, and battle for glory in one of kiteboarding’s most iconic locations.

programme.title: Blind Ambition
programme.desc: In a world where limits are defined by sight, one man dares to see beyond. Gerrard Gosens — totally blind adventurer, Paralympian, Everest summiteer, and recipient of the Order of Australia Medal — sets his sights on a challenge no (totally Blind from Birth) human has ever completed: conquering the 20 Bridges circumnavigation of Manhattan Island. Battling currents, cold, and crushing fatigue, Gerrard and his team must navigate one of the most iconic open water swims on the planet, at night. This is a story of courage without boundaries, of finding light in total darkness, and of one man and his teams fight to etch his name into history’s Ides.A film by Anthony Gordon

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Cape Verde 2025
programme.desc: The new season of the GWA Wingfoil World Cup begins in Ponta Preta, Cape Verde and the top global wingfoilers are battling out for the 2025 GWA Wingfoil Wave World Title. Thrilling wingfoil action determines what’s happening on the water. The legendary waves of Cape Verde are set to be the stage for the opening round of the Wave discipline on the GWA Wingfoil World Tour.

programme.title: Transat Jacques Vabre 2023 - Summary 1
programme.desc: First summary of the Transat Jacques Vabre 2023 with a start disrupted by very difficult weather and the first arrivals in the Ultim class.

programme.title: Freestyle Pro Tour 2025 Geneva
programme.desc: Once again, the world’s best freestylers have gathered for the first half of the Freestyle Pro Tour’s two-stop finale. As per tradition at this point, traditional fin Freestyle will be taking a back seat in Geneva, in favor of a focus on the other two disciplines on tour – Tow-In and Foilstyle. Geneva will be the only Foilstyle event of the 2025 season – meaning a champion will be crowned at this event, alongside the Tow-In World Series champion marking an end to the two-part competition that started at the Boot Dusseldorf at the beginning of the year.

programme.title: Freestyle Pro Tour 2025 Naxos Greece
programme.desc: The Freestyle Pro Tour is more than excited to return to the island of Naxos. Once again, the tour is gathering on the beach in front of Sun Kyma, where the last year’s event with a full fleet of 50 riders and unforgettable vibes on and off the water. The wind is strong with up to 35 knots on big days. Strong north winds mean side on shore conditions, which give the spot its bump and jump Character.

programme.title: Lords Of Tram GKA Big Air Kite World Cup France 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The second stop of the GKA Big Air 2025 season happened at Lords of Tram in the legendary spot of Barcarès, France, powered by the epic Tramontana winds that sweep down off the snow-capped Pyrenees. Reigning Big Air Twin-tip World Champions, Spain’s Jeremy Burlando and the Netherlands’ Zara Hoogenraad, will be on hand to defend their titles.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Dakhla - Morocco 2025
programme.desc: A full roster of 28 men and 16 women, from a total of 16 countries around the world, are set to join the line-up in Dakhla for five days of intense action that could have a key bearing on who takes the titles. Reigning world champions, France’s Capucine Delannoy and Brazil’s Gabriel Benetton, top the Kite-Surf rankings as they head to the season’s penultimate stop in Dakhla, Morocco, on the Sahara desert’s coastline.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Cape Verde 2025
programme.desc: The new season of the GWA Wingfoil World Cup begins in Ponta Preta, Cape Verde and the top global wingfoilers are battling out for the 2025 GWA Wingfoil Wave World Title. Thrilling wingfoil action determines what’s happening on the water. The legendary waves of Cape Verde are set to be the stage for the opening round of the Wave discipline on the GWA Wingfoil World Tour.

programme.title: Lekkarod 2025
programme.desc: Depuis 10 ans, la Lekkarod est une course majeure du mushing en Europe. Affiliée aux fédérations nationale FFST et internationale IFSS, elle est une étape de la Coupe du Monde. Chaque année, une centaine de mushers et leurs chiens prennent le départ des 9 étapes de la Lekkarod, ou de celles des Trophées !For the past 10 years, the Lekkarod has been a major mushing race in Europe. Affiliated with the national FFST and international IFSS federations, it is a stage of the World Cup. Each year, around a hundred mushers and their dogs take part in the 9 stages of the Lekkarod, or those of the Trophies!

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Monte Croce Dolomites Winter Hike
programme.desc: Wonderful winter day hike to a WWI bunker and then up to see Yaks - winter furry cows and then to a refuge while enjoying the views of the Dolomites.Magnifique randonnée dune journée dhiver jusquà un bunker de la Première Guerre mondiale, puis jusquà voir des yaks - des vaches à fourrure dhiver, puis jusquà un refuge tout en profitant de la vue sur les Dolomites.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata In The Dolomites Climbing Possnecker Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2025 3
programme.desc: Cette 3e et avant dernière étape servait de répétition du grand final de demain où, si la météo le permet, la course franchira le col de la Forclaz. Ce col situé au pied du Grand Mont est le théâtre d’une communion, sans égale depuis39 ans, entre les coureurs et les milliers de spectateurs massés à 2.374 m.

programme.title: Pierra Menta 2025 4
programme.desc: Axelle Gachet-Mollaret et Lorna Bonnel remportent cette 39e édition de la Pierra Menta avec classe. Chez les hommes, Xavier Gachet etWilliam Bon Mardion simposent et réalisent un doublé historique 10 jours après leur titre de champion du monde par équipe

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Cardiff Half Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Cardiff Half Marathon is back for its 22nd year and this years event promises to be bigger and louder than before. This race has attracted over 30,000 people from all over the world, making it Waless largest mass participation and multi-fundraising event, with over four million pounds expected to be raised for brilliant causes. Welcome to the Oysho Cardiff Half Marathon.

programme.title: The First Second - Gediminas Grinius
programme.desc: Running with Gediminas means exploring the mental techniques hes continuously developing to both cope with pain and get on the podiums of the worlds most difficult ultra-trails. Or how a Lithuanian veteran of the Iraq War turned weakness and trauma into personal progress by running with his mind!

programme.title: MDS 120 Cappadocia 2025 Eng
programme.desc: In the 2025 Marathon des Sables 120 Cappadocia, we follow the adventure of Pierre Borgella and his cousin Léo Lefebvre, who take on the 120 km of the event over 4 days and 3 nights in self-sufficiency. The adventure is even more enormous for Pierre because he lost a leg following an accident and he decided to participate in this race LIKE EVERYONE ELSE.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 4 - Sunny Stroeer F
programme.desc: Two weeks after paying off her student loans, Sunny Stroeer left her job as a strategy consultant, moved into her astro van, and began running and climbing full time. Since then, she has gone to break records and climb summits no woman has done before. In Episode 4 of Ungrounded, Stroeer shares how she pushed herself to tackle some of the world’s highest peaks.(English version with French subtitles)

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 1 - Caroline Gleich
programme.desc: Caroline Gleich, a world class ski mountaineer, summited Mt. Everest last spring as part of her #ClimbForEquality campaign to raise awareness for gender equality. In Episode 1, Gleich overcomes her own struggle after tearing her ACL to rise to the top for all women. (English version with French, Italian, German and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: The First Second - Gediminas Grinius
programme.desc: Running with Gediminas means exploring the mental techniques hes continuously developing to both cope with pain and get on the podiums of the worlds most difficult ultra-trails. Or how a Lithuanian veteran of the Iraq War turned weakness and trauma into personal progress by running with his mind!

In Episode 1, Gleich overcomes her own struggle after tearing her ACL to rise to the top for all women. (English version with French, Italian, German and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Adamello Short Trail 35km 2025
programme.desc: The “Adamello Short Trail” (AST) is a 35 km long run with about 2.200 m of positive gain, to be runin self-sufficiency, organized by ASD Adamello Ultra-Trail in collaboration with the Unione dei Comuni Alta Valle Camonica. The maximum time to finish the race is 10 hours.L« Adamello Short Trail » (AST) est une course de 35 km avec environ 2 200 m de dénivelé positif, à parcourir en autonomie. Elle est organisée par lASD Adamello Ultra-Trail en collaboration avec lUnione dei Comuni Alta Valle Camonica. Le temps maximum pour terminer la course est de 10 heures.

programme.title: Adamello Trail 100km 2025
programme.desc: ”Adamello Trail” (AT) is a 100 km long run with 6.050 m of elevation gain, to be run in semi self-sufficiency. The organizer is ASD Adamello Ultra Trail, with the cooperation of the Unione dei Comuni Alta Valle Camonica. The maximum time allowed to finish the race is 31 hours.L« Adamello Trail » (AT) est une course de 100 km avec un dénivelé positif de 6 050 m, à parcourir en semi-autonomie. Lorganisation est assurée par lASD Adamello Ultra Trail, en collaboration avec lUnione dei Comuni Alta Valle Camonica. Le temps maximum autorisé pour terminer la course est de 31 heures.

programme.title: Marathon des Sables - The Legendary 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Welcome to the 39th edition of the MDS Legendary, held in April 2025, three months after the inaugural MDS Atlantic Coast adventure in Morocco. There are 1,000 of them, from 52 different nationalities, and they will have to cover 250 km in the desert in complete autonomy: this means that, apart from drinking water, nothing is provided during the 7 days of the race.

programme.title: Golden Trail World Series 2025 Race Recaps - Episode 8 Sierre Zinal Eng
programme.desc: Many line up at the start, but only a select few have the honor of writing their name into the Sierre-Zinal winners’ list. Even fewer get the chance to do it twice. That was the case for two athletes, who each claimed their second victory in this legendary race (31 km, 2,200 m+). This marks the perfect closing to the regular season of the Golden Trail World Series (GTWS) 2025, before everything is decided at the Ledro Sky Trentino Grand Finale.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

Or how a Lithuanian veteran of the Iraq War turned weakness and trauma into personal progress by running with his mind!

programme.title: Sardinia Trail 2025
programme.desc: Athletes from 15 different countries compete in this 3-stage trail running event covering 100 km and 4000 m of elevation gain. The stunning routes of the Sardinia Trail are a magnet for trail running enthusiasts, highlighting the fusion of sea and mountain, nature and history, through unspoiled and mysterious landscapes. Des athlètes de 15 pays différents saffrontent lors de cette épreuve de trail en trois étapes, couvrant 100 km et 4 000 m de dénivelé positif. Les parcours époustouflants du Sardinia Trail attirent les amateurs de trail, mettant en valeur la fusion entre mer et montagne, nature et histoire, à travers des paysages préservés et mystérieux.Atleti provenienti da 15 nazioni diverse si sfidano in questa gara di trail running in tre tappe, che copre un percorso di 100 km e 4000 m di dislivello. Gli splendidi percorsi del Sardinia Trail sono una vera e propria calamita per gli appassionati di trail running, esaltando la fusione tra mare e montagna, natura e storia, attraverso paesaggi incontaminati e misteriosi.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealand’s nine Great Walks faster than they’ve ever been done before, using human power alone. programme.title: Quick Cuts - Mr. Basketball’s Journey: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This documentary-style content chronicles the rich history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters, from their founding in 1926 to their rise as world-class athletes and entertainers. It highlights their groundbreaking 1948 victory over the Minneapolis Lakers, which helped legitimize black athletes in professional basketball. The story focuses on Mannie Jackson, a former player turned executive, who saved the team from extinction in the 1990s and revitalized their global brand. The Globetrotters’ influence on basketball, their unique blend of comedy and athleticism, and their philanthropic efforts around the world are also showcased, cementing their place as an iconic basketball and entertainment institution.

programme.title: Quick Cuts - Mr. Basketball’s Journey: 75 Years of Globetrotter Magic
programme.desc: This documentary-style content chronicles the rich history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters, from their founding in 1926 to their rise as world-class athletes and entertainers. It highlights their groundbreaking 1948 victory over the Minneapolis Lakers, which helped legitimize black athletes in professional basketball. The story focuses on Mannie Jackson, a former player turned executive, who saved the team from extinction in the 1990s and revitalized their global brand. The Globetrotters’ influence on basketball, their unique blend of comedy and athleticism, and their philanthropic efforts around the world are also showcased, cementing their place as an iconic basketball and entertainment institution.

programme.title: Losing Is Worse Than Death | The Bill Tierney Documentary
programme.desc: Coach Bill Tierney is a legend. Over his five decade coaching career, he's accomplished almost everything: NCAA Championships, Coach of the Year honors, induction into the Hall of Fame. The last accomplishment left for his resume? A PLL Championship. Philadelphia finished 2-8 in Coach Tierney's inaugural year at the helm. Now in his second season, Tierney is aiming to right the ship and has his sights on one more ring.

programme.title: 2025 Golden Stick Award Race
programme.desc: The Golden Stick Award is an award given to the player who accumulates the most scoring points throughout the Championship Series. In its history, the winner has been on the team who lost the championship title. This year we followed four of the best goal scorers in the world through their quest to be the first player to win the Championship Series trophy and the Golden Stick Award.

programme.title: University of Texas Documentary
programme.desc: 3 years ago, pro lacrosse player Kyle Hartzell stepped on the campus of University of Texas at Austin as their new club lacrosse team head coach. Now they are a top MCLA program competing for championships. TLN went to Austin, TX during the most anticipated game of the Longhorn's season to uncover what makes their program so special.

programme.title: Through X
programme.desc: Joey Spallina - Paul Carcaterra visits Syracuse, N.Y. to pull back the curtain on the biggest name in College Lacrosse: Joey Spallina. In this episode of THROUGH X, Spallina speaks on wearing the No. 22 at Syracuse, shares his goal to return the Orange to NCAA Championship glory, and shows you how to score his signature behind-the-back goal.

programme.title: TLN Facility Tours
programme.desc: Johns Hopkins & Clemson: Explore two top-tier lacrosse programs as TLN takes you inside their world-class facilities. Visit Johns Hopkins in Baltimore, MD, home to the legendary Blue Jays, and tour the iconic Cordish Lacrosse Center and Homewood Field. Then, head to Clemson, SC, for an exclusive look at the nation's premier women's lacrosse facilities.

programme.title: Through X
programme.desc: Paul Carcaterra heads to Evanston, IL to visit with Northwestern's Izzy Scane. Izzy has been a dominant force for the Wildcats since she first arrived on campus. With a National title, the Tewaaraton Award winner, and record shattering season – she has cemented herself as an all-time great. We also went to Charlottesville, VA to dissect the elite game of Connor Shellenberger: a hometown hero, and arguably the best player in history for the University of Virginia.

programme.title: Through X
programme.desc: We head to Denver, CO to profile Ethan Walker: arguably the greatest shooter in college lacrosse. While also uncovering why the storied success of the Denver program has been fueled by top Canadian talent. We also went to Princeton to uncover the speed and power of Michael Sowers: An attackman who's mental approach to the game has risen him to record-breaking success within a program built on legendary offensive lacrosse players.

programme.title: Through X
programme.desc: We travel to Loyola University to breakdown the basketball influenced playing style of Pat Spencer – While storying his evolution to becoming arguably the best playmaker in college lacrosse. We also travel to Albany to explore the Danes' attack factory led by Connor Fields and Tehoka Nanticoke this spring. We learn how these guys came to lacrosse, the coaching philosophy of Scott Marr, and how the Thompsons laid the groundwork for a new style of play in upstate New York.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 10, Romania
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 11, World Log Lift Championship
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 12, Lithuania
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 13, Portugal
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 14, Martinique
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 15, Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 16, World Finals Turkey
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 1, Norway - World strongest Viking
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 3, Lithuania - Log lift World championship
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 5, Latvia
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 6, Serbia
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 7, Bulgaria
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 8, England
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 9, Finland
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 10, Finland - World championship under 105 kilograms
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 11, Romania Part 1
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 12, Romania Part 2
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 13, Curacao
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 14, Portugal
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 15, Dubai World grand finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 16, Dubai World grand finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 3, Lithuania
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 6, Canada (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 3, Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?
