programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Stärkster Wikinger der Welt
programme.desc: Dieses Jahr kamen 14 Athleten aus der ganzen Welt nach Fefor, um sich in 6 harten Disziplinen zu messen. Wir werden typische Wikinger-Disziplinen bei sehr schweren Bedingungen im Land von Schnee und Eis sehen, Weltrekorde und Athleten wie den Titelverteidiger Krzysztof Radzikowski, die stärksten Jungs aus Holland und Deutschland und viele mehr.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL FIBO Power
programme.desc: Der nächste Halt in der stärksten Liga der Welt ist die Hauptstadt der Muskeln, die größte Anzahl von starken Schultern pro Kopf in der Welt und natürlich der mächtigste Gastgeber in der Strongman Champions League auf dem Planeten. Es ist eine FIBO - die größte Messe auf dem Planeten Erde und die zweite Etappe der Strongman Champions League 2019, in Köln, Deutschland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Türkei
programme.desc: An einem spektakulären Strand in Alanya wurde die MLO Strongman Champions League Türkei von tausenden von Zuschauern über einen zweitägigen Kampf verfolgt. Mit 12 Athleten am Start von 6 schwierigen Disziplinen, wie Marble Stone Lift, LKW-Ziehen und Deadlift mit Autos. Und mit dem Comeback von Travis Ortmayer / USA, ehemaliger Steinkönig und Weltranglistenkandidat. Gewinner von mehreren SCL-Wettkampfen in der Vergangenheit.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Holland
programme.desc: Der viermalige stärkste Mann Hollands, Alex Moonen und der "Flying Dutchman" Kelvin de Ruiter, treten hier in Holland gegen 12 andere stärkste Männer der Welt an. Insgesamt gab es 6 Wettkämpfe, von denen 3 in dieser Folge gezeigt werden: Der erste Wettkampf, ein LKW-Ziehen von 17.000 kg über 25 Meter in maximal 75 Sekunden, war auch für den Weltmeister im LKW-Ziehen, den holländischen Vizeweltmeister Kelvin de Ruiter, eine echte Herausforderung, aber sehen Sie sich hier seine erstaunliche Technik an.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Holland (Teil 2)
programme.desc: Der stärkste Mann Hollands, Alex Moonen und der "Flying Dutchman" Kelvin de Ruiter, treten in Holland gegen 12 andere stärkste Männer der Welt an. Es gab insgesamt 6 Wettkämpfe, 3 davon in dieser zweiten Folge; eine Viking-Press von 150 kg mit dem aktuellen Weltrekordhalter Luke Herrick. Die fünfte Disziplin, ein Front Hold von 25 kg, wird von den Athleten geliebt oder gehasst und schließlich die Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Russland
programme.desc: Ein unglaublicher TANK PULL von 50.000 kg war Teil der SCL RUSSLAND. Das hat es noch nie gegeben! Nicht nur ein Tank Pull wurde hier durchgeführt, sondern auch die Viking Press/ Deadlift Max und Log Lift Reps waren spektakuläre Disziplinen, die es hier in Russland zu sehen gab. Mit Mikhail Koklyaev als Moderator der Veranstaltung war auch der ehemalige Top 3 Weltmeister aus Russland dabei.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Serbien
programme.desc: In der diesjährigen Ausgabe auf der Balkanhalbinsel haben wir das neue Talent aus Estland Marko Remlik zusammen mit Sebastian Kurek aus Polen und dem gelben Spitzenreiter Kelvin de Ruiter im Wettbewerb.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Finnland
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski aus Polen und Aivars Smaukstelis aus Lettland sind die Strongman-Zukunft dieser Tage. Mateusz ist im Moment der beste Mann der Welt, den es zu besiegen gilt. Er ist erst 25 Jahre alt und so ein fantastischer Strongman. Sie kommen nur für einen Sieg hierher. Aber es gibt noch 12 weitere starke Athleten in dieser Folge, die auch den Titel von Finnland wollen.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Finnland (Teil 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz führt nach Tag 1 (vorherige Folge), dicht gefolgt von Aivars Smaukstelis und Zake Muluzi aus Großbritannien. Alles sehr spannend! 5 Disziplinen in dieser Folge: Baumstammheben, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Portugal
programme.desc: Auf dieser Station haben wir einen neuen starken Debütanten: Oleg Sylka aus der Ukraine. Er ist das neue Talent, das gegen die alten Champions wie ZSydrunas Savickas und Brian Shaw und den Stoltman Brother aus dem Vereinigten Königreich antreten wird. Dieses neue Talent Oleg ist ein großartiger Charakter und wir werden ihn in der Folge in Portugal strahlen sehen.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Callio
programme.desc: In Callio befindet sich das tiefste Bergwerk Europas/ 1500 Meter tief, wo die MLO Strongman Champions League auch 1 Wettkampf durchführte. Der Forward Hold, auf 1500m Tiefe/ auch eine Art neuer Rekord/ sowas wurde noch nie zuvor gemacht. Spektakulär und neu im Strongman-Sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Ukraine
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter ist hier, um seinen Titel bei der SCL Weltmeisterschaft im LKW-Ziehen zu verteidigen. Aber dieses Jahr will ein weiteres starkes Wettbewerberfeld seinen Titel. Über 3 verschiedene Pulls mit 3 verschiedenen Trucks und 14 Athleten am Start, wird es für alle schwierig werden.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Karibik
programme.desc: SCL Ausgabe Curacao 2019 war ein großartiger Wettkampf, zwölf Powerboys aus der ganzen Welt lieferten eine großartige Show an den weißen Stränden und bei 35 Grad Celsius Hitze auf den Karibischen Inseln. Zwei Wettkämpfe fanden am Freitag am Strand des wunderschönen Sunscape Resorts statt, die anderen drei wurden am Samstagabend in der Nähe der weltberühmten schwimmenden Brücke in Willemstad abgehalten.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Dubai
programme.desc: Die Strongman Champions League, die im Meydan Grandstand in Dubai ausgetragen wurde, hatte einige große Namen wie Mateusz Kieliszkowski aus Polen, Brian Shaw aus den USA und Krzysztof Radzikowski auf der Liste. Vor dem Burj Khalifa absolvieren die Athleten den Deadlift Max und 4 weitere schwere Disziplinen an einem anderen Ort in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Weltmeisterschaftsfinale (Teil 1)
programme.desc: Mit neuen Orten im Kalender, über 16 Stationen, einer Ausstrahlung in über 100 Ländern und in ihrem 13. Jahr kann die MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) wirklich als die größte Strongman-Liga der Welt angesehen werden. Der letzte Wettkampf über 2 Episoden der MLO Strongman Champions League wurde in Porto, Portugal, ausgetragen. Dieser Wettbewerb in Portugal ist voll von denkwürdigen Leistungen und starken Ergebnissen.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL Weltmeisterschaftsfinale (Teil 2)
programme.desc: Mit neuen Orten im Kalender, über 16 Stationen, einer Ausstrahlung in über 100 Ländern und in ihrem 13. Jahr kann die MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) wirklich als die größte Strongman-Liga der Welt angesehen werden. Dieser Wettbewerb in Portugal ist voll von denkwürdigen Leistungen und starken Ergebnissen und dies ist das Finale!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 2, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 3, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 5, Strongest Viking
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 8, Portugal
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 9, World Records (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 10, World Records (Part 2)
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 11, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 1)
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 12, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 2)
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 13, Ukraine
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 14, Romania
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 1, Finland Stage 1
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 2, Holland Part 1
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 4, Serbia Part 1
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 5, Serbia Part 2
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 14, Gibraltar
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 15, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - World's Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - Stage 11 - SCL Poland 2023
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - Stage 12 - SCL Poland 2023
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - Stage 13 - SCL Cyprus 2023
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League kicks off its 2014 season in Martinique.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 16, Malaysia (World Finals Part 2)
programme.desc: Who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League - we find out who is crowned as world champion today in the second part of the final epsiode

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 3, Holland
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 4, Finland
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 5, Bulgaria
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 6, Latvia
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 7, Croatia
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 8, Poland
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 3, Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League - SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Jumping International La Baule - Derby
programme.desc: The Derby at La Baule is an awaited event amongst horse enthusiasts. Classified as a CSIO 5*, competitors rush against the clock for a prize money of 40,000 euros. They will have to beat all sort of obstacles with a height of 1.45m across the field. The competition is hard and not all combinations are ready to challenge the fences, water and ramps in the way.Watch the best moments of the 2019 competition.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this month's show, we look back on Boyd Exell's memorable 2018 driving season and travel to Reykjavik to learn more about the Icelandic Horse breed. Also, we will be visiting Gina Schumacher in Geneva to catch up on the action from the Longines FEI World Cup Jumping series. Welcome to FEI Equestrian World.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 2
programme.desc: This time, we are in Bordeaux to find out who will be crowned the FEI Driving World Cup Champion and we return to Iceland to learn more about their equine enterprises. We will also visit one of the leading coachbuilders in the world to see how horseboxes are made and travel to Abu Dhabi for the series opener of the Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep7 - Stockholm
Polo Rider Cup Competition - Deauville International Polo Club vs Empire Club of Coachella Valley
programme.desc: Deauville International Polo Club is going against Empire Club of Coachella Valley in this first stage of the 2021 Polo Rider Cup at the Polo Club of Chantilly. Both teams have been preparing hard for this moment and are ready to make the most points to advance to the next stage. Who will win?

programme.title: Le Grand Prix du Faubourg
programme.desc: Relive the highlights of the CSI 5stars accumulator competition against the clock over obstacles from 1.50 -1.60 m height, progressive difficulties and with a joker.

programme.title: Event Rider Masters - Arville
programme.desc: The Event Rider Masters takes a change in direction and heads to Belgium. We arrive to Arville Castle for the third leg of the series. Within the walls of the family estate of Guillaume de Liedekerke, Arville is an impressive venue with an extensive amount of woodland, hills and a beautiful lake. Relive the action at Arville in the 2019 edition of the Event Rider Masters.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Abu Dhabi
FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 4: Horsewomen
programme.desc: This week Ride celebrates three extraordinary horsewomen and the captivating connection they have with their equine friends. We showcase exhebition work from American dressage star Sabine Schut-Kery, experience life through a lens with Poland’s fine art horse photographer Katarzyna Okrzesik-Mikolajek, and witness the holistic approach to healing in South West England with renowned trainer Connie Cox.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 5: Heroes & Healers
programme.desc: This week Ride exercises military precision with the mounts of the Household Cavalry at the British Army’s London Barracks, and sees second chances given to troubled residents at Achterhoek horse shelter in the Netherlands. We’re in the back seat with Polish driving expert Piotr Mazurek and catch up with this year’s Longines FEI Rising Star Award winner, Germany’s Greta Busacker.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Abu Dhabi
FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 4: Horsewomen
programme.desc: This week Ride celebrates three extraordinary horsewomen and the captivating connection they have with their equine friends. We showcase exhebition work from American dressage star Sabine Schut-Kery, experience life through a lens with Poland’s fine art horse photographer Katarzyna Okrzesik-Mikolajek, and witness the holistic approach to healing in South West England with renowned trainer Connie Cox.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 5: Heroes & Healers
programme.desc: This week Ride exercises military precision with the mounts of the Household Cavalry at the British Army’s London Barracks, and sees second chances given to troubled residents at Achterhoek horse shelter in the Netherlands. We’re in the back seat with Polish driving expert Piotr Mazurek and catch up with this year’s Longines FEI Rising Star Award winner, Germany’s Greta Busacker.

programme.title: Event Rider Masters - Arville
programme.desc: The Event Rider Masters takes a change in direction and heads to Belgium. We arrive to Arville Castle for the third leg of the series. Relive the action at Arville in the 2019 edition of the Event Rider Masters.

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail we've got two action-packed deer hunts. Black Garlock and Clint McCoy hit our Kentucky lease in hopes of finding a mature buck. programme.desc: Wow, holy Eastern Sierra! It's been a full month of trout shows, and we've been trying to cover as much as possible with trout fishing in the creeks above Bishop. We teamed up with Jared at South and Sabrina Lake, and then we did a day hike back into God's country to Long Lake, which was incredible. Today on Stoked on Fishing, we're stopping by Mammoth's one and only Rick's Sports Center to get schooled on some fly fishing on the Owens River, just above Lake Crowley. programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Bishop Creek Fishing
programme.desc: Growing up in Southern California, there’s a special spot my dad would always take us: the Eastern Sierras. If you love the outdoors, trout fishing, and pure beauty, the Sierras have it all. We especially enjoy venturing up in the fall when the weather changes, the fall colors start popping, and the fishing is phenomenal. The Sierras offer endless options for camping, hiking, and fishing, and that’s exactly what we’re doing for the next couple of weeks. Join us as we explore some creek fishing around Park's Resort, lake fishing at South and Sabrina Lake, and then head into the backcountry for an epic day hike. Don’t miss out on this adventure through one of the most picturesque and diverse regions of California!

Today on Stoked on Fishing, we're stopping by Mammoth's one and only Rick's Sports Center to get schooled on some fly fishing on the Owens River, just above Lake Crowley. I promise you, this is an ending to a show you won't want to miss. Ryan got a big one; Ryan got a big one!

programme.title: What are the Chances
programme.desc:
Luke Cranney has been guiding sheep in Idaho for 11 years, and packing in Alaska for 2. Everything lined up, and he got the chance to go on a hunt of his own. However, unlike many sheep hunts they had no scouting or plan in place. This was a true adventure hunt filled with bad weather, beautiful animals, and uncanny good luck. Follow Luke, Austin and Brady on an experience they will never forget.

programme.title: Mongolia Wild Sheep Experience!
programme.desc: Follow along as THE EXPERIENCE travels to the ends of the earth in search of the largest sheep species known to man. You won't want to miss this quest for the Hangay Argali and Altai Ibex! AND never before seen footage of a wild Snow Leopard!

programme.title: Giant Alaskan Yukon Moose Grand Slam Club Ovis North American Big Game
programme.desc: On this Episode of The Experience we are hunting giant Alaskan Yukon Moose! Definitely an Experience of a lifetime chasing around Grand Slam Club Ovis North American Big Game!

programme.title: Kentucky Whitetail with Dan Catlin
programme.desc: In this episode of The Experience, Dan Catlin takes us on his Whitetail deer archery hunt in the great state of Kentucky with Salt River Outfitters! This story does have a sweet ending, but as all bow hunters understand regarding shot placement, you can be a hero or a zero within a fraction of an inch. Dan keeps it real as he shows us the ups and the downs of his experience in the Kentucky deer woods!

programme.title: Marco Polo, The Pinnacle of Tajikistan with TJ Sanchez
programme.desc: T.J. Sanchez travels to Tajikistan in the search for what most sheep hunters believe to be the Pinnacle of "Big Game Hunting"! The Marco Polo of Tajikistan are one of the largest sheep species in the world. The harsh, cold environment and sometimes elevations of more than 17,000 feet make this one of the most challenging as well as one of the most remote hunts on the planet.

programme.title: Taking a Bow to a Gun Fight

programme.title: Bow Hunting Wasatch Moose

For years he made it on every hunt he could fit into his schedule trying to log film & photos to hopefully turn this into a career one day. Well as you've probably seen he has done just that and come a long way since 2014! But we all start somewhere and this is where Dallas got his start.

programme.title: California Big Horn Determination
programme.desc: Russ Hawkins was well on his way to successfully hunting all four of the North American Sheep when he suffered a terrible injury that left him almost completely paralyzed. After extensive rehab and a never give up attitude, Russ once again found himself on the mountains chasing what most in the hunting industry perceive as the greatest big game hunting accomplishment!

programme.title: The Australian Water Buffalo Experience
programme.desc: Mark Peterson travels to the land down under in pursuit of Australian Water Buffalo.

programme.title: Under The Influence - Canada Stone Sheep
programme.desc: If you hunt sheep, there had to be someone or something that influenced you. My name is Dallas Cota and I was hooked after a close friend took me out for 5 miserable days on an Alberta Bighorn sheep hunt. A couple years later, I harvested my Bighorn and soon after that, I booked a Dall's sheep hunt in the Yukon. I'll never forget the day I told Jason Hairston I was booked to hunt white sheep, his response "Right on! Next up will be your Stone sheep!" I candidly laughed until I realized he wasn't joking. He assured me that someday it would happen, if I wanted it bad enough. I owe a lot to my influencers, without them, I would never have been "under the influence".

programme.title: Tajikistan Experience #3 - A Dream Come True

programme.title: Hunting Dagestan Tur with Shikar Safaris
programme.desc: Jason Price travels to the steep slopes and unforgiving terrain of Azerbaijan in pursuit of the Dagestan Tur. Some believe this to be one of the most physically challenging and difficult hunts in the World!

programme.title: Canadian Cold Weather Whitetail EXPERIENCE
programme.desc: Dan Catlin travels north of the boarder to Saskatchewan Canada in search of a dark horned wilderness whitetail with Worldwide Trophy Adventures (WTA). Braving temps of -40 degrees Dan connects on a big bodied Canadian whitetail that is his largest buck to date. Hunting is certainly NOT judged by the number of inches, but by the EXPERIENCES we enjoy. You won't want to miss this EXPERIENCE in the frozen Canadian wilderness…

programme.title: Mexico Whitetail Deer Hunting Experience!
programme.desc: The Experience travelled south of the border in to Old Mexico for some dark horned Mexican whitetail deer hunting. From the deep snow in Canada to the cactus country of Mexico, there's no where Dan Catlin won't go in search of a Deer Hunting EXPERIENCE!

programme.title: The Boulder Elk Experience with TJ Sanchez
programme.desc: TJ Sanchez has played the waiting game for a Utah Elk permit for almost 20 years. In 2023, he finally drew the one Non Resident Muzzleloader tag in one of the top units in the state, the Boulder. After 12 days hunting public land, TJ finally got his opportunity at a Bull of a lifetime.

programme.title: I Can, and I Will - Zane Foust Dall Sheep
programme.desc: To some, hunting is a weekend adventure... it's something you do to pass the cold winter months. To others, it's a passion, maybe a lifestyle. To Zane Foust, and many others like him, it's an escape to a place he loves, away from the hospital and the doctor's office. Hunting is his inspiration in life to keep going, to keep fighting. A special thanks to Frank Maestri for his huge heart and generosity that made this hunt possible!

programme.title: Bow Hunting for Whitetail in Iowa
programme.desc: Follow Dan Catlin's quest for a Whitetail Deer in Iowa. Patiently, they wait all week until finally, they see the perfect opportunity to complete his EXPERIENCE!

programme.title: Saskatchewan Black Bear with Mark Peterson
programme.desc: Mark Peterson travels to Saskatchewan in search of Black Bear with his bow!

programme.title: The Half Slam Experience
programme.desc: Follow Char Catlin's quest for the 4 North American Wild Sheep as she heads to Ole Mexico in search of a Desert Bighorn Sheep. Char collected a 10 plus year old ram that anyone would be proud to take!

programme.title: Spain Experience, Beceite and Gredos Ibex with Shikar Safaris
programme.desc: Jason Price travels to Spain in pursuit of the Beceite and Gredos Ibex. Spain has an abundance of game with a variety of species! Due to such large populations, great accommodations and incredible food, hunting the Beceite and Greedos Ibex are typically easier than most other goat hunts around the world. Filmed by Sawyer Peacock edited by Warner Brown.

programme.title: Largest Public Land Ram in Utah 194"
programme.desc: We were very fortunate to play a roll in capturing Kyle Ekker's hunt on film. Kyle Ekker grew up in Green River Utah where he developed his love of hunting, chasing mulies on the Book Cliffs. He has worked for the Emery County Sheriff's Office for 30 years where he is currently employed as a captain. He has been a member of the Utah FNAWS for the last 10 years and through this he is able to share his passion for the outdoors & wild sheep. In December of 2015 he drew the highly coveted Rocky Mountain Bighorn Sportsman's permit. This tag gave him the opportunity to hunt sheep from the beginning of September to December 31st on almost any open units in the state. He hunted every opportunity that he had he could in pursuit of his dream ram. On November 30th things came together for him and he was able to harvest a very magnificent ram. With an unofficial green score of 194" this ram will be the largest public land ram ever killed in the state of Utah.

programme.title: Deja Vu Youth Whitetail Experience
programme.desc: Grand Slam Club Ovis "Youth 3 Antler". It seems like yesterday that Casey and I were hunting whitetails as kids. It was an incredible Experience having the opportunity to take our boys back to where it all began! In this episode 7 year old Ethan gets a chance at his first Texas Whitetail buck; while 9 year old seasoned whitetail hunter Drew goes for one as well. Hope you all enjoy this Texas free range whitetail management hunt!

programme.title: Mid Asian Ibex - The Kyrgyzstan Experience with Shikar Safaris
programme.desc: Jason Price travels to the Tian Shan Mountains of Kyrgyzstan with Worldwide Trophy Adventures and Shikar Safaris in pursuit of some of the largest ibex in the world. Hunting is done on horseback as well as spot and stalk. Jason and Sawyer find a literal hole in the wall for shelter as they endure extreme weather conditions on a hunt of a lifetime!

programme.title: Western Hunting & Conservation Expo / Our Wyld Life / EP1
programme.desc:
Welcome to Our Wyld Life where host Kristy Titus and her husband, Yogi, take viewers along on their day-to-day lives, full of adventure. After relocating to Wyoming, hunting, outdoor and shooting sports recreation are literally in their backyard. The couple is truly making their home on the range while developing their new homestead and enjoying life in the cowboy state.
In our premiere episode, we show you a little bit of what it's like being a Wyoming resident, in the winter. After a tough start, Kristy makes it a great week with familiar faces and many new ones, in what is one of the most fun shows of the year! If you didn't make it in 2023, it's a must to attend next year! Also, you'll be introduced to the newest (and longest eared) members of the family! Kristy shows off her baby mules...lots more of the mules to come! When they aren't out on an adventure trekking deep into the backcountry with their horses and mules, you'll find them preparing for the next opportunity to do so.
Our Wyld Life presents the journey of life out west in Wyoming.

programme.title: What are the Chances
programme.desc:

Follow Luke, Austin and Brady on an experience they will never forget.

programme.title: Hunting with a Lost Lemming: Okayest Hunter's 2022 deer hunting season kickoff!
programme.desc:
The crew from the Okayest Hunter podcast thought it'd be a good idea to start a hunting show, but they wanted to do something different, and it needed to align with the brand, mission, and ethos of the Okayest Hunter. Basically, it can't be too serious. So we thought, hey, let's make the "Office" show, but for hunting.
Our hunting season is chock full of humility as we miss place things, take too long to pick out our tree, injure ourselves, miss deer, lose arrows, and more. However, we had one of our best and most fun seasons yet! Follow along as we release new episodes as our 2022 deer hunting season unfolds. We assure you it'll be worth getting all the way to the end!
Cheers to chasing shooter bucks in the deer woods and never passing on what makes you happy! We hope you can relate as we share our shenanigans with everyone!
Okayest Hunter Show, season one: We'll See How it Goes, Episode one: Hunting with a lost lemming.

programme.title: Spring Turkey Extravaganza [Part II]

programme.title: Early season Fox Trapping

programme.title: Land Trapping 101
programme.desc: The Fur life teaches you all about Land Trapping. From Bobcat to Fox and everything in between.

programme.title: Trapping Life

programme.title: Pope and Young
programme.desc: Corey talks about his first Pope and young experience. A tale about the heart pounding moment we all dream of feeling as a huge buck heads your way. This Wisconsin Giant makes the mistake of walking into close range.

programme.desc: A long lost story about the One Giant buck that gave Corey Brossman the Buck Fever. While Freelancing for Matt Morrett in Missouri a Giant buck steps into the field. After a few deep breaths, Corey gets his composer together and lays down some amazing footage.

programme.desc: Corey tells an old tale about Flying fish and shooting them with bowfishing gear. These Asian Carp fly into the air making them great targets on the Illinois River. The arrows are flying and the guys are having fun.

programme.desc: Corey meets up with Rick Cruter from Beyond to hunt TV. They're bowhunting in Ohio for Giant Whitetails. The location in which they're hunting isn't normal. In fact, its almost Like Shed Hunting!!

programme.desc: One of the coolest shots ever filmed with a bow and arrow. You don't want to miss this exciting Crocodile hunt from Zimbabwe. programme.title: Giants in Green Bay
programme.desc: Mathew is joined by Cindy Braun the CEO of AMS Bowfishing as they travel to Green Bay Wisconsin in pursuit of giant common carp. Also known as Title Town USA home of the Green Bay Packers but also giant Carp. Also known for its world class Walleye fishing, these invasive carp must be kept in check as they destroy spawning habitat for the native fish. Non-stop bowfishing action as the Giants of Green Bay move into the shallows and make for some great night time bowfishing.

programme.title: Ghost Stories, Crayfish of Unusual Size and Turkey Invasions
programme.desc: On this episode of Outdoor Weekly we have ghosts? Aliens? Bigfoot? Escaped government experiment looking to exact revenge on those that condemned it to a life of torment and misery? We also have a North Dakota man who thinks he broke the state record for walleye but it is disqualified for one key reason. A Pennsylvania man who DOES break a state record for catfish and no he didn't use mousefish as bait. Crayfish, crawfish, crawdad, it doesn't matter what you call it, a water plant worker found a MASSIVE specimen that could have been mistaken for a lobster. A new gang is stirring up trouble in a rural town – a gang of turkeys are terrorizing residents. And last but not least, we check in with the beautiful Jana Waller to give us updates on this year's bear season.

programme.title: Don't Miss
programme.desc: Watch this cinematic adventure as Paul Lawver and Joel Port hit public land on the Eastern Shore of Maryland chasing Sika a.k.a. the elusive marsh ghosts. Sika deer (technically a species of the elk family) were released in the swamps of Maryland in the early 1900's. Sika originate from Thailand/Japan/East Asia and have flourished in Maryland so well, their season co-insides with whitetail yet have their own separate bag limits.

programme.title: Slow down for more birds
programme.desc:
You set the pace in the field, and if you're in a rush so is your dog. That means less time in a scent cone and more missed birds.
Scott Linden of Wingshooting USA TV shows you how, and explains why, you should dial things down a bit when it comes to covering a field or covert.
If you want more tips on dog training and bird hunting, go to: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Hunting dog tailgate exam, part one
programme.desc:
Your best hunting partner needs some TLC ... especially after a hunt. wingshooting USA TV host Scott Linden provides the first part of three, helping you check him from nose tip to tail and ensure he's healthy, safe, and ready to go the next day.
Today, it's all about your dog's coat. We'll cover why it's important to get him off the ground, how "training" for the exam is critical, and what to look for from injuries to parasites. Your dog will stay healthier, well-rested, and ready to go the next day.
You'll also see some fun and exciting bird hunting footage from a hunt where the tailgate exam became crucial.

programme.title: Take a newcomer hunting - here's how
programme.desc:
Safety first, but then what? Author and TV host Scott Linden outlines some ways to encourage, motivate, and then help a new hunter on their first hunt.
From weather to shooting tips, to interacting with the dog, and what really counts on the hunt, Scott offers suggestions to ensure everyone has fun.
For more tips on hunting, dog training, and finding places to go: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Identify your best prospect for a new hunter
programme.desc:
Picking the right new hunting partner is an art and a science ... and while there's no wrong way, some ways are righter than others. Author/TV host Scott Linden outlines some tips on finding the right person, how to set expectations, and what to tell them - and show them - before you make "the ask."
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: The new-hunter best recruiter is your dog!
programme.desc:
Who doesn't love hunting dogs? The magic of their performance, excitement, and the adrenaline rush of a flush! One easy way to start a new hunter is to invite them to help train your dog.
Simple, short, convenient - there's no downside. And who wouldn't appreciate a little help with dog training?
Plus, some cool footage of a hunt with excellent dog works.
For more on starting a hunter, finding places to hunt, and dog training, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com.

programme.title: Ideas for finding new places to hunt
programme.desc:
Find upland birds on waterfowl production areas, and more tips on accessing public hunting areas are two of the topics ... as well as a great place to headquarter: Huron, South Dakota.
Watch some exciting bird hunting footage, too.
Find more information at www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Tailgate exam, part 2: wheels
programme.desc:
Part two covers your dog's "wheels," his feet. Enure a fantastic hunt tomorrow by keeping his feet healthy and injury-free with these step-by-step, toe-by-toe instructions.
Geet the entire exam in written form at HappyJackInc.com.

programme.title: Be nice, see where it gets you
programme.desc:
Walk-in hunting spots are not always easy to find. Here's an example of how to find them and the bonuses you might find along the way.
From hunting with a pro baseball player, to finding a black pheasant, to discovering new public-access spots in Huron, SD, there's a few lessons here.
Plus, some fun footage of a South Dakota pheasant hunt.
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Peak performance on Day Two: feed your dog strategically
programme.desc:
In the first 20 days of this season, my wirehair Flick had already hunted over 200 miles. He still scratches the RV door every morning, eager for another day of chukar chasing and quail quests.
I manage to keep up (mostly) with coffee and pain reliever. Flick, on the other paw, gets his stamina from Dr. Tim's dog food.
If your dog hunts multiple days in a row, it might be worth a look at how important food is to his performance. I asked Doctor Tim Hunt to share his thoughts on that, but first, a hunting story.

programme.title: Tailgate exam, Part 3: His steering wheel
programme.desc:
Okay, we've checked his body, his feet. But the tailgate exam isn't over until you've checked a dog's head – the steering wheel of your hunting machine. Like your truck, you're not getting very far without one! Put off that tall cold one for a couple more minutes. You'll have a fully-functioning hunting partner for the next day … and you won't die of thirst!
In this video, I'll show you where to look, what to look for and why ... and also how to remedy most common issues that might kibosh your next day's hunt, from getting stuff out of eyes and ears, to ensuring weeds and crud stay outta those places and more!
I'll take you step-by-step through all the deep, dark places that harbor danger and irritation on your dog's head so he's ready and rested for the next day's hunt.
And if you need remedies for any of the problems outlined, you can find them at www.happyjackinc.com.

programme.title: Get high, become a better bird hunter
programme.desc:
Not like that! I mean, boost your altitude - even just a bit - and you'll be able to keep a closer eye on your dog. If you're paying attention, you'll have a crucial half-second extra to get ready for a safe, sure shot.
I'll show you how - what you might use to get "up there" a little, what to look for in your dog's behavior, and why it's worth the effort.

programme.title: What's in my vest ... and why
programme.desc:
"Don't leave home without" is more than a cliche' from a TV commercial. What should you take on your next bird hunt, for you and your dog? Here's some advice on critical stuff, and what you might leave home ... without jeopardizing your safety or comfort - or you're dog's!
Somewhere in my personal vest is everything I need to shoot as well as possible (no smart remarks, please), stay found or get found, keep my dog safe and healthy, and help me survive a night or two in an emergency.
I'll show you all of it, and how to keep it from getting lost somewhere in the middle of nowhere!

programme.title: Your dog hurts - here's why
programme.desc:
I seem to be getting a lot of related questions since the season ended – most about aches and pains in our four-footed hunting buddies. And us!
The difference is, dogs won't show it like we do, with gripes and limping, complaints and wincing. They are way too loyal and hard working. It's why we love 'em.
You might already know this, but veterinarians tell me dogs seldom show pain. What they do, is slow down. Their pace in the field drags, they're slow to get out of their crate.
Maybe they won't jump onto your tailgate or training table.
That's probably arthritis, and it affects most dogs over eight years old. But here's the scary part: twenty percent of dogs show signs as early as one year old.
In this video, I'll show you how to prevent arthritis, manage it if your dog already has it, and what to avoid so he doesn't get it prematurely!

programme.title: Fuel your bird dog's peak performance ... but NOT with carbs!
programme.desc:
We hunt to watch our dogs work. So, stand by for plenty of that. But first, let me relate my last season. I tracked Flick's mileage. He averaged twenty-five miles a day, over almost fifty days in the field. I'm a lousy shooter, and okay trainer … so I'll attribute his stamina to my dumb luck, and his performance dog food.
If you want to watch your dog in the field day after day, heed some of the advice I got from Doctor Tim Hunt, a veterinarian, sled dog racer, and developer of the food Flick eats. He says the fuel you put in your dog directly impacts his ability to hunt hard, especially on a long hunting trip. He should know. His food has powered a bunch of Iditarod winners … and my guy Flick.
In this video, you'll learn what the key ingredients are in a dog food, how they work, and why. Hint: the most important component in your dog food is probably NOT what you think it is.

programme.title: Your bird dog's "suit of armor" and how it helps him reach his peak
programme.desc:
In previous videos, we've covered a dog's … headlights, wheels and steering wheel …
Now, it's time to cover a dog's largest organ, that I'll call his "body and paint," his skin and coat. Like a suit of armor, they protect a dog from virtually everything that can put him on the injured reserve list when he could be hunting.
To help you - and him - through a long season, I'll outline many of the problems that are easily handled without a vet visit, if you have a few things on hand, their potential causes, and what you can do about them so you both get back to hunting ASAP.
I'll also settle that proverbial campfire debate once and for all: are hair and fur are the same thing?

programme.title: Hunting dog peak performance on multi-day hunts
programme.desc:
There is a "magic dust" that can help your hunting dog's muscles recover overnight and keep him performing at his best on the second, third, and fourth days of a long hunting trip. The key is knowing what it is, how it works, and when to give it to him...and what NOT to give him at the same time!
I'll outline the how and why in this video ... plus some excellent dog work from Ruggs Ranch in Oregon just for fun!

programme.title: That ingredient sneaky dog food makers don't want you to know about
programme.desc:
Want less poop, and more dazzling performance from your hunting dog?
Generally, less poop means your dog food contains the highest-quality protein and his body is utilizing almost all of it.
But crafty dog food makers often hide the key ingredient ... the one that will tell ALL about the quality of the protein in your hunting dog's food. And it's the easiest way to tell how good your dog food is.
This ingredient is seldom on the label. You'll have to quit browsing puppy pictures on the Internet and go to the dog food maker's website. If you want more of his food fueling peak performance and less piling up in the yard, it's worth the effort.

programme.title: Four tips to get the most from your walk-in and public-access bird hunt
programme.desc:
So, you've picked out a public-access spot. The first thing you should do? Don't go there. You need a plan.
Here are four suggestions based on my trips to some of the hundreds of public access spots near Huron, South Dakota. I'll save you time, money and aggravation while helping you become a more productive bird hunter.
Your bird dog will thank you.

programme.title: 4 tips make your bird hunting road trip better ... for your dog
programme.desc: You'll both arrive at your bird hunting destination rested, relaxed, and ready for action with these four tips for hunting dog comfort and security.

programme.title: Go along to get along in bird hunting country
programme.desc:
Be a good temporary neighbor in hunting hotspots like Huron, South Dakota, and you'll reap benefits of all sorts. Here's a "field guide" to getting the most from your hunting destination.
Dial it down: Things move a bit more deliberately in rural America; we can too. Breathe deep at the gas station, tavern or sporting goods store. Fit in, and residents will welcome you … you'll have "a guy" in town.
Good guest: Let's give as good as we get: buy local, drive like locals, drink like locals. "Pay it forward," respect diverse values, and wire gates open more often.
It's their office: Cattle, crops, drilling, are part of the economic landscape. Empty shotgun shells can sideline a combine. Cows are walking thousand-dollar bills. An unattended campfire is like burning down someone's office.
The downside is obvious: locked gates, drive-by's while wrestling a flat tire. The payoff is also crystal clear: access, friends when you need them, useful information, textures and colors that make a hunting trip truly epic. Well, unless you shoot like me.
Free info pack: Access maps, Discounts, Prizes
I learned most of these lessons in the Ringneck Nation of Huron, South Dakota and so can you. Go to HuntHuronSD.com and request a free information pack and you're entered to win one of three hunting trip prize packages. See you there.

programme.title: Blood and guts! Simple field first aid for your dog.
programme.desc: When to race to the vet, and when you can do it yourself when a dog gets cut, scraped and scratched. Here are some simple tips to figure out what to do, how to do it, and why.

programme.title: A place for everything makes your bird hunting trips EPIC for you and your dog
programme.desc:
It's your big road trip of the season … and you've got a place for everything, and everything in its place. Right?
If you answered no, or maybe, or what? let's take those niggling details from forgotten to second nature for a trip that's more relaxed, productive, and fun … for both of you. In this case we're headed for Huron, South Dakota …
You may have your own system that works just fine, but maybe somewhere in here is something you hadn't thought of. I've learned most of this the hard way … so you don't have to. I forgot something, couldn't find it when I needed it, or inconvenience became emergency.
You'll also see some of the stuff I use to keep my dog healthy and at his peak on long hunts ... uncommon, unthought-of and definitely must-have if you want the best from your four-footed hunting buddy.

programme.title: The "Fearsome Four" ingredients that should never be in your dog's food
programme.desc:
Have you looked closely at your dog food label? There could be stuff in there that could cause allergy, seizures, even cancer. And it's in more dog foods than you think!
If you want to ensure your hunting dog's health and peak performance, learn what shouldn't be in dog food. Here's the list.
Oh, and enjoy some cool dog work from Horseshoe Curve hunt club in Oregon.

programme.title: Bird dog training: one (baby) step at a time

programme.title: Bird hunters: your face is the key to hunting dog training success
programme.desc: Your dog keys off your face as often as your verbal commands. If he can see your mug, he's more likely to follow some key commands.
