programme.desc: Elect4ronic collars are great training aids, but there are times when you should keep the transmitter in your pocket. Here are some of them.

programme.title: Better bird dog retrieves: don't swipe it!
programme.desc: He worked hard to produce that bird, so what do you do the minute he brings it back? Swipe it! Here's why and how to do it right.

programme.title: Is your bird dog sensitive? The answer is yes.
programme.desc: Keep your hunting dog on an even keel by anticipating the stress-inducers and minimizing their effect. YOu'll get better performance.

programme.title: Four tips to public access bird hunting
programme.desc: Before you go hunting, STOP. Lay a plan. Scott offers four tips to get you to more public access bird hunting.

programme.title: Bird hunting ROAD TRIP! Make the drive better for your hunting dog
programme.desc: Your dog needs to arrive fresh, safe, and rested. Scott outlines four ways to ensure he's at his peak when you drop the tailgate on that long-distance hunting destination.

programme.title: Bird hunting: get along by going along and you'll get the most from any hunting destination
programme.desc: Adjust your pace, check your ego at the county line, and you'll have "a guy" in town. Scott offers tips on how being a good visitor might open a gate or two for the best public-access hunting.

programme.title: A place for everything on your bird hunting road trip
programme.desc: Pack your rig for efficiency, dog health, and productivity. You'll be ready for most situations, able to find and access public ground, and your dog will be happier too.

programme.title: Be nice, and skunkwise, with a steady dog
programme.desc:
A chance encounter on the road leads to an invitation to hunt ... that's the good news. That in turn led to new friendships and (luckily) some solid dog work. The worst-case could have put a real damper on the day.
Some advice on accessing walk-in ground, and footage of excellent dogs working wild birds are also included in this short lesson in common courtesy and its rewards.

programme.title: Finding public access bird hunting ground ... here's how
programme.desc: Here are a number of tips and tactics on finding walk-in hunting land in South Dakota, including lesser-known and uncrowded spots most people drive past. Today, we focus on the how and why ... from digital mapping to where to go on those free hunting spots. Hunting strategies are also covered, as well as what bird species hang out where.

programme.title: Coachella ... for bird dog guys!
programme.desc: Here's an event that showcases you and your dog's skills, whatever your experience level. While we enjoy great dog work, learn more about safe shooting, and hunting strategies.

programme.title: Want worms? Take your dog hunting.
programme.desc:
Your dog picks up worms every time his feet hit the ground. You touch them, or he licks you, and you've got them too.
Here are smart, simple ways to deal with the most common worms, and why it's important if you want him - and you - to perform at your peak.

programme.title: Public access bird hunting: have a plan
programme.desc: Here are four tips to get you into free bird hunting spots. Digital scouting, alternate access points, use all available resources from game departments to hotel clerks, scouting tips to save time and aggravation, and how to hunt once you get there to stay away from the crowd ... if there is one.

programme.title: DESTINATION: bird hunting somewhere in South Dakota
programme.desc:
First in a series on places to hunt wild birds on public land ... from over 30 years traveling 26 states in pursuit of wild birds.
Why? Hunters are the first - and biggest - force in conservation. Our gun, ammo, bow and arrow purchases fund virtually all habitat and wildlife management. If hunting is to survive so your grandchildren can experience the magic we do, or if we're to keep people hunting, we've got to help them find new places to hunt ... so they'll continue to buy guns and ammo.
Don't get your undies in a wad. I won't share any place that's not already "discovered," or your secret spot, but I will share places that can stand a little more pressure. Never will there be a lat/long or specific honey holes ... you gotta earn them! But here's your starting point.
And if you want more, go to https://findbirdhuntingspots.com
Let me know what you think. Scott

programme.title: Three tips to better bird hunting ... get your head in the game
programme.desc:
Simple is better, especially when it comes to shooting birds flushing all around you. Here are three bird hunting tips that will help you connect more often and make your dog even happier.
It starts with your head, literally.
Made possible by LegacySports.com/pointer

programme.title: Bird hunting, after the point: these tips make all the difference between "fetch" and "*$^%$(^*^!"
programme.desc:
Once your dog stands the bird, the rest is up to you. What you do and how you do it is the difference between "fetch" and "&*%##@(!"
Here are some tips on approaching the dog and the bird, foot placement and more.
See more videos and tips at https://legacysports.com/pointer

programme.title: Bird hunters: shoot like a predator, make your dog happy
programme.desc:
Focus. Yep, not just on the flying bird, but on the beak. You've got enough distractions, from a dog on point to the beautiful scenery to your judgmental hunting buddy.
Here, I'll show you how to achieve a laser-like vision that ultimately puts more birds on the ground. And that's what your dog wants, isn't it?

programme.title: Bird dog emergency ... or not? Here's how to tell the difference.
programme.desc:
It's a jungle out there. And a desert, stubble field, swamp, and popple thicket. Yuk. Every one of those hunting scenarios can cut, scratch, sting, bite or infect your dog. And each needs your attention if you hope to finish the day … or the season.
I'll outline the serious stuff that if your human hunting partner had one of these problems, you'd go to the emergency room. For the other stuff, over-the-counter and D-I-Y solutions may be all you need. If you have them handy, the day or the season are saved. I'll show you the stuff I've got ready in my truck.

programme.title: Better bird hunting with a better shot pattern
programme.desc:
In the days of silk fly lines, English fly anglers would utter "God save the queen," before setting the hook. This gave the trout time to take the fly in his mouth and turn, setting the hook himself rather than the angler pulling it away too soon.
I'm convinced it's good advice for bird hunters too, for a slightly different reason.
Here are two easy ways to put the odds in your favor … and keep your bird dog happy.

programme.title: All in one piece: the complete tailgate exam keeps your bird dog safe and healthy after every hunt
programme.desc: Do this first ... after every hunt. You'll enjoy a long and productive bird season thanks to a healthy, happy dog. I'll give you step-by-step instructions on what to look for and how.

programme.title: Will your dog shoot someone this season?
programme.desc:
In the heat of the hunt, safety goes out the window sometimes. Here are some key moments when firearms, dogs, and humans don't always play well together.
Here are the goofs that are easiest to forget when feathers fly and dogs, well, act like dogs.

programme.title: Bird dog training: One step at a time
programme.desc:
A dog doesn't just "get it." He needs to learn every skill in increments ... bits and pieces that eventually add up to a flawless retrieve, steady point, or simply to come when called. Here are tips to ensure you start right, and end with a polished performance.
More tips: findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Bird dog training: your face helps, no matter how ugly you are!
programme.desc: Like me, you might have a "face for radio," but your dog doesn't mind. He looks to you, literally, for direction. Here's how it works, why, and how to use it to your advantage in the yard and in the field.

programme.title: Get your bird dog back ... let him savor that retrieve
programme.desc:
Dogs naturally want to take a shot bird and bury it, or eat it, or at least keep it away from you. But if you aren't grabbing it the moment he arrives, he may be a bit more willing to "share."
Here are tips on how to make your dog a better retriever brought to you by www.findbirdhuntingspots.com, your source for dog training and public-access hunting information.

programme.title: Bird dog basics: when to keep your e-collar out of the transaction
programme.desc: There are times when the best thing to do with an electronic training collar is nothing. I'll show you when and why to avoid using this helpful training tool.

programme.title: Your bird dog is more sensitive than you think
programme.desc: Introduce your dog gradually to new sounds, people, habitat types and he'll become a better hunter. How? open your own eyes, ears and nose.

programme.title: Honest is the best policy with your hunting dog
programme.desc: Tell the truth, so to speak, when training your bird dog. He'll trust you more, learn faster, and both of you will be closer to peak performance. Here are some common mistakes we make that might be fun or funny to us, but booger up your dog training.

programme.desc: From dog training to shooting better, here is advice that will help you become a better bird hunter.

programme.title: Upland Nation University: bird hunting tips and tactics, Vol. 3
programme.desc: Tips, tactics, advice and insights that will help you become a better dog trainer, bird hunter and wingshooter. You might even find more public-access and walk-in hunting ground! Your dog will thank you.

programme.title: Four tips to better bird hunting
programme.desc: Dog training, shooting and strategy from America's favorite TV host.

programme.title: Better bird hunting: tips and tricks
programme.desc: Eleven minutes of tips and tricks for you and your bird dog

programme.title: Upland Nation University
programme.desc: A continuing series to help you become a better bird hunter, dog trainer and wingsohoter.

programme.title: Highlight reel: Southern Illinois mixed bag
programme.desc: Our first of two visits to big whitetail country ... for upland birds. A ton of dogs and hard-flying birds, some incredible dog work and okay shooting. Training tips, game cooking advice and a showcase of a rare Italian breed.

programme.title: Highlight reel: Southern Illinois mixed bag, part 2
programme.desc: Return to Illinois, where we chase wily ringnecks and bobwhites among a variety of habitats with young and old dogs. Hunting tips, dog training advice and more.

programme.title: Oh say can you see ... your muzzle?
programme.desc:
Have you ever thought about how your mind works when you shoot a shotgun? "Aiming," versus pointing, "swing through" or some other style, foot position, one eye or two? No matter your preference, your head needs to "see" the shotgun muzzle, right? Not overtly, but subconciously.
Here's a video that might help explain it. Maybe. You decide, and see if there's something there to help. Made possible by HiVizSights.com.

programme.title: Upland Nation University: bird hunting tips and tactics
programme.desc: From the first part of a "tailgate exam" for your dog, to getting (more) ready to shoot, here is a short course in dog handling and bird hunting.

programme.title: Upland Nation University Part 4
programme.desc: Tips and tactics for bird hunters and dog trainers, this week including the full tailgate exam, shooting straighter with a different stance, and a dog training tactic you may not have thought about.

programme.title: See the bird by not seeing it
programme.desc: Training your eyes - and head - to see the bird or clay target in the right way at the right time is critical to hitting it. It's a simple, but critical process starting with unfocused eyes, then zooming in, laser-like, on the target. Here's how.

programme.title: Snow? Go inside and slow down to bag more birds
programme.desc: Even in crappy weather, you can practice your shotgunning ... indoors. But most of us rush many aspects of the move-mount-shoot process and never quite get dialed into the target as a result. Try this simple drill and maybe you'll hit a few more birds or clay targets.

programme.title: Slow down for more birds
programme.desc:
You set the pace in the field, and if you're in a rush so is your dog. That means less time in a scent cone and more missed birds.
Scott Linden of Wingshooting USA TV shows you how, and explains why, you should dial things down a bit when it comes to covering a field or covert.
If you want more tips on dog training and bird hunting, go to: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Get high, become a better bird hunter
programme.desc:
Not like that! I mean, boost your altitude - even just a bit - and you'll be able to keep a closer eye on your dog. If you're paying attention, you'll have a crucial half-second extra to get ready for a safe, sure shot.
I'll show you how - what you might use to get "up there" a little, what to look for in your dog's behavior, and why it's worth the effort.

programme.title: Bird hunters: shoot like a predator, make your dog happy
programme.desc:
Focus. Yep, not just on the flying bird, but on the beak. You've got enough distractions, from a dog on point to the beautiful scenery to your judgmental hunting buddy.
Here, I'll show you how to achieve a laser-like vision that ultimately puts more birds on the ground. And that's what your dog wants, isn't it?

programme.title: Bulls, Bucks, & Beards!
programme.desc: Crafting the ultimate outdoor experience is Rick Taylor's cup of tea. Rick is a lifetime outdoorsman and currently works for BPI Outdoors as their Social Media Strategist. In this episode, he shares his passion for hunting, guiding and just being outdoors. He has had the opportunity to guide elk hunts in Tennessee, pass his love of hunting to his kids, and help his dad harvest his first buck later in life. This is a must-watch if you love hunting. Don't miss it!

programme.title: Bucket List
programme.desc: Charles puts the latest gear from Dead Air Silencers to the test in this action-packed episode. Meanwhile, the team makes a veteran's dream come true by taking him on a bucket-list helicopter hunt for hogs, delivering an unforgettable experience.

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: Craig and his sons embark on an exciting mule deer hunt across the rugged terrain of South Dakota, testing their skills and teamwork. Meanwhile, Brett is in Kansas, pursuing ducks in a fast-paced waterfowl adventure.

programme.title: Help From Above
programme.desc: A heaven sent early morning turkey hunt with Colten and Mark Scroggins. The Apex Turkey Ninja TSS will make you a believer in killing turkeys with a .410!

programme.title: Killin Tree
programme.desc: Join WoodHaven's Mike Pentecost as he kicks off his Alabama turkey season , these mountain birds are tough to hunt!

programme.title: Giggles & Gobbles
programme.desc: Colten Scroggins and the whole family return to the blind to see if they can call one of the other gobblers back in to their setup. A family that hunts together stays together!

programme.title: American Ninja ... hunting dogs!
programme.desc:
The best hunting dogs in the country are challenged at the Invitational Test of the North American Versatile Hunting Dog Association. Canine athletes compete against a standard that requires search, point, back, retrieve, and honor … on land and water. Owners and dogs face the ultimate hunting situations as well as heat and humidity and we're there to cover it.
Plus, Scott offers tips and advice on dog care, diet, training, public-access hunting and more!

programme.title: Habitat and a mixed bag of dogs and birds in Kansas
programme.desc: Scott visits Flint Oak Plantation in Kansas for incredible habitat, a long string of dogs, and mixed bag.

programme.title: Canada Bear - Leah Plunkett Bear Hunting
programme.desc: Brandon Plunkett's Daughter, Leah, takes a black bear in Canada.

programme.title: Canada Bear - Todd's Second Bear
programme.desc: Todd Yohe is not doen in Canada, yet.

programme.title: Canada Bear - Todd's First Bear
programme.desc: Todd Yohe chases black bear in Canada.

programme.title: Canada Bear - Belton Fire
programme.desc: Firefighters black bear hunting in Canada.

programme.title: Serber's Bear
programme.desc: Canada bear hunt with a bow in the snow and cold temps.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Phillip Vanderpool's "40 Something" birthday, celebrated the only way he knows how - flinging arrows & stacking longbeards. This hunt in honor of long-time friend and hunting companion Reece Hogins (1918-2014.)

programme.title: Sooner State Success
programme.desc: Phillip Vanderpool heads to Oklahoma to share in the turkey hunting heritage with two youth hunters and their fathers.

programme.title: Bow Hunting Osceola Gobblers
programme.desc: Some of the best hunts come down to the wire. Phillip Vanderpool heads to Old Long Beard Outfitters in Florida for some Osceola Gobblers.

programme.title: Noah and His Nature
programme.desc: As with most great hunting stories, this one holds infinite meaning as Host Phillip Vanderpool and 16 year old Noah Walters share the turkey woods through the 2015 Kidz Outdoors event. Phillip guides Noah through the hunt, while Noah shares his nature of love and passion with everyone involved.

programme.title: Conquering Your Fears
programme.desc: Norissa doubts herself after missing a shot on an excellent trophy, but recovers her confidence soon after and learns not to judge herself too harshly. PH Marius patiently guides them and helps them build their hunting career and confidence as huntresses. Norissa has to conquer her fear of heights in this episode as Jen tries to convince her to take a leap of faith, by jumping out of an airplane.

programme.title: First Experiences In Africa
programme.desc: After a whirlwind two weeks, Jen and Norissa find themselves in Africa. Not knowing the culture, the animals or their new producer Kappie. Their journey starts with learning how to track these majestic animals in Africa, and Norissa finds herself being pushed out of her comfort zone on the first trip. Follow their journey from the start and see how they grow into experienced and talented huntresses.

programme.desc: An exciting series following the outdoor hunting and fishing adventures of three Canadian outdoorsmen with a passion for the chase: Ryan Tomuschat, Devin Skipton and Mark Thompson. Join along as they Double Down and go all in on this exciting pastime.

programme.title: World Of Watersports Ep303: Profile of Professional Kayaker Adrian Mattern
programme.desc: Extreme Kayaking is a way of life for Germany's Adrian Mattern. The attraction for Adrian is to get to know new places, cultures and people on every expedition, as well as mastering the extreme mental and physical challenges. Adrian's always looking for new spots on the world map: new rivers and waterfalls, new techniques and styles and he's always thinking "outside the box".

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep106: Shark Divers Part 1
programme.desc: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums. Shark Divers focuses on this diverse and eclectic dive group…each with different motives in their fascinating fields.

programme.title: Airtime Ep32: The Titans of Windsurfing - Maui, Hawaii
programme.desc: Big-wave windsurfing history catches up with the present as European Champion Tristan Boxford takes us inside the progression of the sport. On Maui, Hawaii, meet the legends; hear how it all started and where it's going. Hang out with pioneers like Robby Naish, Jason Polakow, the Angulo brothers, as well as windsurfing's present rulers Levi Siver, Kauli Seadi and Daida Moreno. From board-shaping to riding big waves at Jaws and Hookipa, learn about the birthplace of a sport.

programme.title: Sports Adventure Ep613: Whitewater Kayaking Africa’s Zambezi River
programme.desc: World-renowned kayaker Steve Fisher brings together a crew of big-water pros to experience the force of Africa’s mighty Zambezi River at record levels. Steeped in the brotherhood of kayaking, Fisher, and his fellow paddlers, run head-on into some of the most radical rapids ever recorded

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep107
programme.desc: Liquid Edge highlights the kiteboarding doc With A Kite; profiles one of surfing’s greatest legends, Tom Carroll; checks out the O’Neill Coldwater Classic in Canada; and unveils Sligo, Ireland…an extreme surf sweet spot. Also featured is female big wave surfer, Maya Gabriel; an inside look at Pipeline from The Essence of Surfing; and wakeboarding innovator Dean Lavelle gives us his view on wakeboarding today.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef: World's most amazing coral reef
programme.desc: This expedition to the Great Barrier Reef is designed to study the health and resilience of one of the world’s most amazing coral reefs. The expedition’s goal is to collect data about the world's most remote reefs and build a picture of how reefs are faring in today's changing climate.

programme.title: Extinction Soup
programme.desc: Extinction Soup is a documentary about the ground-breaking efforts to stop the international trade of shark fins. The story follows filmmaker Philip Waller on his quest to document the efforts of conservationist Stefanie Brendl, founder of Shark Allies, as she fights to educate lawmakers and helps pass legislation that will ban the trade of fins and the consumption of shark fin soup - the driving force behind the slaughter of millions of sharks every year.

programme.title: Liquid Edge Minisodes - Canyoning, Jet Ski Free Ride, and Feeding Stingrays
programme.desc: The Deap Canyoning Team defies logic as they leap from high cliffs into deep canyon pools. This realatively new extreme sport called Canyoning, is breathtaking and spectacular viewing!

programme.title: Xplash Ep107
programme.desc: Xplash brings you spectacular water-related action from around the globe. Today we'll catch some big-air freestyle kitesurfing in the Canary Islands, bodysurf giant waves in Ireland, go whitewater kayaking in Iceland and check out Hydro Flight at the Poseidon Games in Australia.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep109: Whale Sharks, Feeding Frenzies, and Great White Sharks.
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV studies Whale Sharks kept in a giant tank and then takes a Deeper Dive by explaining shark hearing, shark feeding frenzies and Great White Sharks.

programme.title: Hot Water Ep103: V8 Jet Sprinting Superboat Championships
programme.desc: Hot Water showcases the world’s best in adrenalized water-related motorsports. This episode features Round 3 of Jet Sprinting from Cabarita in New South Wales, Australia. V8 Unlimited Superboats are the top racing class in Jet Sprinting with the boats being unrestricted.

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep806 Paddling the Madawaska River - Ontario, Canada
programme.desc: For the first time ever, host Ken Whiting trades his whitewater kayak for a whitewater canoe on the Madawaska River.

programme.title: Xplash Ep108
programme.desc: Xplash brings you eye-popping water-related action from around the globe. In this episode, we’ll witness the underwater mastery of free-diver and current World Record holder, Arnaud Jerald; dive into a shark tank with BMX Pro Kriss Kyle; and meet some fearless shark divers.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep112: Deep White - Why Sharks Attack
programme.desc: Deep White explores ways to research sharks to determine why sharks attack and to study innovative ways to train sharks in order to prevent future attacks. Sharks are surprisingly intelligent and able to perform complex tasks. Sharks can distinguish different signals and cues in feeding routines and they develop strong bonds with their trainers.

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures: Islamorada Permit and Bones in the Florida Keys, USA
programme.desc: Captain Rick Murphy heads to Islamorada in the Florida Keys to fish for bonefish and permit with Captain Mark Krowka.

programme.title: Blue World Ep502: Muck Diving in Florida + Iceland…The World's Clearest Water
programme.desc: Host Jonathan Bird travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It’s rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean’s most remarkable, and strange, creatures.

programme.title: Next Stop Ep110: Island of Hawaii
programme.desc: Highlights include The Hawaii Forest & Trail, Kahua Ranch, swimming with dolphins, Mauna Kea Beach Hotel, a volcano helicopter tour and Kona Brewfest.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep141
programme.desc: This World of Watersports episode features highlights of the Extreme Sailing Series from Los Cabos, Mexico, the World Kiteboarding Tour stop in Egypt, and the Tiree Windsurfing Classic in Scotland.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles: Can Patagonia Handle the Fly Rod Crew?
programme.desc: The Flemings pursue trout in Patagonia with their good friends from Argentina Waters.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep107: Sharks at Palau’s Blue Corner + Denver’s High-Altitude Shark Aquarium
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV dives with an amazing array of sharks at Palau’s Blue Corner, shows how sharks adapt in Denver’s High-Altitude Aquarium and takes a Deeper Dive with Spiny Dogfish Sharks.

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep108
programme.desc: Liquid Edge highlights the birthplace of the coldwater surf scene, Santa Cruz, California; profiles Aussie big wave champ Ross Clark-Jones; and travels to Newfoundland to kayak among the icebergs. Also featured is kiteboarder Billy Parker; free-surfing with Craig Anderson; the world’s toughest kitesurfing marathon; and “Liquid Lens” profiles adventure photographer Erik Boomer.

programme.title: Airtime Ep12: Kiteboarding The British Virgin Islands
programme.desc: Catch wind of a jet-set journey through the British Virgin Islands with British Virgin billionaire, Richard Branson and kiteboarding royalty Martin Vari and Ceridwen Jones. Highlights include a fourteen-mile kiteboarding regatta, magnificent scenery and epic freeriding.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep307: Cliff Diving, Kitefoiling and Waterski Jumping
programme.desc: This WOW episode features Red Bull Cliff Diving in an underground lake in Romania's famous Turda salt mine; the European Kitefoil Championships in Spain; and the Moomba Masters men’s and women’s waterski jumping in Melbourne, Australia.

programme.title: Blue World Ep505: Mayan Underworld - Yucatan, Mexico
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico’s Yucatan, Blue World explores remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, we encounter strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep406: Paddling Papua New Guinea
programme.desc: Among the numerous islands and atolls of Papua New Guinea, Nikki Gregg experiences traditional festivals, charged canoe races and embarks on an exploratory trip down a remote river.

programme.title: Hot Water Ep111: Aquabike World Championship Series Portimao, Portugal
programme.desc: The Grand Prix of Portugal continues with a focus on the Aquabike Runabout Division.

programme.title: Next Stop Ep204: Ixtapa, Mexico
programme.desc: Segments include swimming with Dolphins; sea kayaking; the Zihuatanejo Market; exploring a Coconut Plantation; clay tile making; Las Brisas Ixtapa and live music at Bandidos.

programme.title: Airtime Ep55: Kayaking Norway…Romancing The Rapids
programme.desc: The swollen waterways of Norway’s backcountry provide the challenge as a group of world-class kayakers take on Class 5 whitewater in this adventure of a lifetime. These pros seek out the most difficult lines and spectacular waterfalls set against the wild beauty that's Norway.

programme.title: Xplash Ep109
programme.desc: Xplash brings you amazing action in, on, and near water. In this episode, we’ll fly high with kiteboarder Kevin Langeree; take a look at what's being done to progress the sport of Hydro Flight; and start things off by kayaking from the top of a snow-covered mountain.

programme.title: Blue World Ep604: Exploring Devil's Hole Cave in Nevada, USA
programme.desc: One of the largest aquifers in the United States is located directly beneath Death Valley. Blue World is invited to join a team of scientists working at Devil’s Hole Cave in Nevada and is afforded a once-in-a-lifetime permit from the National Park Service to dive in Devil’s Hole Cave. Fewer than 20 people have ever been allowed to dive in this otherworldly cave system.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter: Country Music vs. Kayak Fishing
programme.desc: What goes together better than country music, bonfires and fishing? Mike links up with fellow Michigan native Sadie Bass! Sadie was a contestant on The Voice in 2022 and is no stranger to the outdoors. But how does she do with her first time fishing in a kayak? How does Mike do playing guitar with her and one of her hit songs? Check out all the fun and great adventures in this episode!

programme.title: Lost In Indonesia
programme.desc: We journey to a long forgotten zone deep in the northern Sumatran area with world-class professional surfers Mikala Jones, Marti Paradisis and Bryce Young. They search this region of Indonesia for incredible waves and have fabulous adventures along the way. The final session is testament to their willingness to go the extra mile to score the perfect wave.

programme.title: Next Stop Ep406: Central Oregon Coast
programme.desc: Segments include Sand Dune Exploring via Dune Buggy; The Oregon Coast Aquarium; Crabbing via boat in Newport; plus innovative ways to cook Crab.

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep109
programme.desc: Liquid Edge highlights surfing in Mexico in the documentary Gone; surf action with Mexican pro Fernando Stalla; a Storm Surfer profile on Mark Mathews; a look at surf life in Sayulita, Mexico, with Diego Cadena; Adan Hernandez goes off; whitewater kayaking adventures in Croatia; a session with Storm Surfing’s big-wave rider Paul Morgan; renowned French photo-journalist Paul Villecourt trains his cameras on a paddleboard expedition; plus a profile on the birthplace for modern kiteboarding, Leucate, France.

programme.title: Mapping The Blue: World's largest Marine Park
programme.desc: The Cook Islands recently announced the designation of the largest Marine Park on Earth. In stunning 4K imagery, this documentary tells the story of how Kevin Iro, founder of the park, along with his team, use a high tech GIS system to designate multi-use areas inside the pristine park.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV Ep108: Hammerhead Sharks + Blue Hole Adventure in Belize
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV explores the odd behavior of Hammerhead Sharks; goes on a Blue Hole adventure in Belize featuring a friendly shark; and takes a Deeper Dive to study Scalloped Hammerhead Sharks and Nurse Sharks.

programme.title: Hot Water Ep121: F1H2O Powerboat World Championship Tour
programme.desc: Round 2 from Portimao, Portugal, where the mighty Atlantic meets the graceful Arade River, in a country with an illustrious and glorious maritime history, where the waves crash and the sprays soar, the second round of the UIM F1H2O season kicks off.

programme.title: Facing Waves Ep411: Tahiti
programme.desc: Host Nikki Gregg explores the turquoise waters and breathtaking tropical islands of French Polynesia on her stand-up paddleboard.

programme.title: World Of Watersports Ep303: Profile of Professional Kayaker Adrian Mattern
programme.desc: Extreme Kayaking is a way of life for Germany's Adrian Mattern. The attraction for Adrian is to get to know new places, cultures and people on every expedition, as well as mastering the extreme mental and physical challenges. Adrian's always looking for new spots on the world map: new rivers and waterfalls, new techniques and styles and he's always thinking "outside the box".

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep106: Shark Divers Part 1
programme.desc: Shark divers study, photograph and interact with some of the most terrifying creatures on earth. This group of skilled professionals routinely work with sharks out in the wild and in aquariums. Shark Divers focuses on this diverse and eclectic dive group…each with different motives in their fascinating fields.

programme.title: Airtime Ep32: The Titans of Windsurfing - Maui, Hawaii
programme.desc: Big-wave windsurfing history catches up with the present as European Champion Tristan Boxford takes us inside the progression of the sport. On Maui, Hawaii, meet the legends; hear how it all started and where it's going. Hang out with pioneers like Robby Naish, Jason Polakow, the Angulo brothers, as well as windsurfing's present rulers Levi Siver, Kauli Seadi and Daida Moreno. From board-shaping to riding big waves at Jaws and Hookipa, learn about the birthplace of a sport.

programme.title: Sports Adventure Ep613: Whitewater Kayaking Africa’s Zambezi River
programme.desc: World-renowned kayaker Steve Fisher brings together a crew of big-water pros to experience the force of Africa’s mighty Zambezi River at record levels. Steeped in the brotherhood of kayaking, Fisher, and his fellow paddlers, run head-on into some of the most radical rapids ever recorded

programme.title: Liquid Edge Ep110
programme.desc: Liquid Edge examines the subject of surf territorialism and the Aloha Spirit; the beauty and challenge of stand-up paddling in Tahiti; extreme whitewater kayaking. Included is an amazing look behind the scenes of the 3D movie adventure Storm Surfers, plus a spectacular kiteboarding sweet spot.

programme.title: Whales In A Changing Ocean
programme.desc: Wildlife cinematographer Richard Sidey joins an international team of whale research scientists in Antarctica to document their work on how humpback whales adapt to a changing ocean.

programme.title: Travel Quest Ep108: North Pole
programme.desc: The Travel Quest crew takes an icebreaker to the North Pole just in time to make a satellite phone call to wish Bill's mother a happy birthday (she is so shocked she doesn't recognize him). We also track and film the biggest predators on earth…polar bears.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles: In-Depth Look at Brook Trout in West Virginia
programme.desc: We learn about Brook Trout with West Virginia DNR Fisheries Biologist, Brandon Keplinger, TU's Dustin Wichterman, and their children.

programme.title: World of Watersports Ep305: Formula Foil World Championships
programme.desc: The Formula Foil World Championships from Saint Moritz, Switzerland.

programme.title: Blue World Ep507: Sand Tiger Sharks + Marine Biology in Turks & Caicos
programme.desc: Blue World heads to North Carolina to observe how shipwrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing the fish, the sharks are protecting them! Then, we visit the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how to tag sharks!

The expedition’s goal is to collect data about the world's most remote reefs and build a picture of how reefs are faring in today's changing climate.

programme.desc: The Wellerbrucke rapid is a world class kayaker’s dream. Not only offering up great freestyle adventures, it also hosts the Adidas Sick-line Extreme Kayak Championships. This competition is seen through the eyes of 3-time champion Sam Sutton.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef: World's most amazing coral reef

programme.title: Spiritual Makeover with Marianne Williamson - Spiritual Makeover - Part 1
programme.desc: This is not a religious course; rather, it’s a universal system based on love. You think you have many different problems, but you have only one — the illusion of your separation from God, the true nature of reality. We get trapped in illusions (and create our own suffering) when we over-identify with a particular problem or stay stuck in fear-based thinking. This program is here to remind you of a key universal principle: Only love is real.

programme.title: Spiritual Makeover with Marianne Williamson - Spiritual Makeover - Part 2
programme.desc: It’s time to stand in your power and stop buying into the belief that you are wounded beyond repair. God already created the perfect you, and it's an undeletable file.

programme.title: Spiritual Makeover with Marianne Williamson - Spiritual Makeover - Part 4
programme.desc: The ego asks, ‘Who are you to dream big?’ Spirit is ready to show you the answer when you are ready to see all that is possible.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 1
programme.desc: This class primarily focuses on increasing the flexibility and suppleness of your cervical spine (the top 7 vertebrae, otherwise known as your neck). We tend to neglect the neck when we practice/train. It has the tendency to be stiff and weak. So, before we practice some strength building mobility work in the next class, let's stretch it out and create some more space in the areas that tend to hold tension. Get your strap out and get ready for some yummy, feel-good stretches that lengthen the tissues of your neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 2
programme.desc: Now that we've stretched out our necks and created some space in this area, let's add some mobility work to the mix. Most of us tend to focus on strengthening bigger muscles and more obvious joints like our shoulders and hips, and our neck tends to get left out and neglected. This class is all about strengthening the neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Boulder Shoulders
programme.desc: The shoulders are the seat of the neck. They influence the way it moves and positions itself in space. When we strengthen and stabilize the shoulders we free up room for better mechanics in the neck. This class will take you on a journey in all the directions the shoulder can mobilize. Let's go.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Flexion Section (Abdominals)
programme.desc: A strong stable core is truly the foundation for proper movement mechanics. Most of us are stuck in spinal extension. Our ribs flare out and our lower back is overly compressed. We need to learn how to access our abdominal muscles through articulating our spine into flexion. Here's a class that will toughen up your abdominal muscles, and teach you how to flex and segment your spine efficiently.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 2: Befriend
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 3: Align
programme.desc: Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

programme.desc: What if I told you there was a reason you feel tired, achy, and foggy all the time? And what if I told you the solution was healing your body on the cellular level?

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 1: Hormones 101
programme.desc: Your hormones work like a symphony. When every instrument is in tune, they play harmoniously. However, if one instrument is out of tune, or one hormone is out of balance, the entire piece is thrown off. Together, we'll decode your symptoms and work with your body to create hormonal balance. This means clear skin, easier periods, less hot flashes, better sex, and more restful sleep. Yes, it can be that good when your hormones are in check.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 2: Adrenal Glands
programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. In today's lesson, we take a deep dive into the hormones that our adrenal glands produce. We'll start to get an idea of why taking care of and keeping these glands happy is so important.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 5: Estrogen
programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 3: The Thyroid
programme.desc: How common are thyroid conditions? Women are 5 to 8 times more likely than a man to develop thyroid disease. If your thyroid isn't functioning optimally, every single cell in your body will feel it, including your ovaries. A thyroid function that is too high or too low can lead to symptoms that include low heart rate, fatigue, weight loss, and menstrual irregularities.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 9: Detoxification
programme.desc: Did you know that 80,000 toxic chemicals have been released into the environment since the Industrial Revolution? What's worse is that very few have been tested for their long-term impact on human health. Today's session is all about detoxification, the natural process that our liver, kidneys, lungs, lymphatic system, gut, and skin perform daily to get rid of metabolic byproducts that our body produces and toxins that are absorbed from the environment. You'll learn how to avoid toxins and how to address those that you already are carrying due to the nature of the environment, as well as how to optimize your body's ability to detoxify.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 5: Heart Health
programme.desc: Today we learn which tests you should be pursuing for a total view of your heart health and how to synthesize those results systemically.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 7: Hidden Inflammation and Disease
programme.desc: We’ve all experienced inflammation in some form. Today we address how to find this hidden symptom, identify it and its root causes, and stop it in its tracks. There is no optimal health with uncontrolled inflammation.

programme.title: Good Mood Food with Jason Wrobel - Fat is Your Friend
programme.desc: Don’t demonize fat. It’s actually your friend! Today, you will learn the importance of the quality of the fat you’re consuming, how to select the right kind of monounsaturated fats that nourish your brain, and why it’s important to choose the right cooking oils.

programme.title: Good Mood Food with Jason Wrobel - Mindfulness Practices for Mealtime
programme.desc: We’ve all heard about the importance of being present—but how does that translate to meal time? Today is all about how to practice presence at every meal by feasting with your other senses first, and how to recognize how food actually makes you feel.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - 360 Degrees Hips
programme.desc: The hips are the seat of the lower back. If you have low back pain, you will benefit from strengthening and stabilizing the various articulations of the hips. This class will take you on a journey of the hip joint in 360 degrees. When the hips are strong they serve as a foundation for your entire spine. Your spine will move better, function better and feel better when it has the support and stability of the hips.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 5: Heart Health
programme.desc: Today we learn which tests you should be pursuing for a total view of your heart health and how to synthesize those results systemically.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 7: Hidden Inflammation and Disease

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie - My Mother Terrifies Me
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie - I Want to Be Famous
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie - My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.desc: Physical sensation can be a powerful way into the flow state. You may find it harder to breathe in twisting poses; but by elongating the spine and extending upward, you can reap the benefits of the powerful postures in today’s sequence while still maintaining the breath. Practice the essentials of twisting through lunges (Anjaneyasana), Monkey Pose (Hanumanasana), and various side stretches with ample focus on the connection between the breath, the waist, and the spine.

programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 3: The Thyroid
programme.desc: How common are thyroid conditions? Women are 5 to 8 times more likely than a man to develop thyroid disease. If your thyroid isn't functioning optimally, every single cell in your body will feel it, including your ovaries. A thyroid function that is too high or too low can lead to symptoms that include low heart rate, fatigue, weight loss, and menstrual irregularities.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 5: Estrogen
programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.desc: Let’s use a quick analogy: If your body is a car, then reverse is actively gaining weight, neutral is not gaining or losing, and drive is weight loss… Ultimately you have been eating more than you are burning, which is what put the weight on in the first place. By controlling the calories in, we generally shift the car from reverse to neutral. No longer gaining, but not really losing a ton. By adding exercise into the mix we throw the car into drive without compromising your metabolism or muscle mass.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Balancing Hormones for an Optimized Metabolism
programme.desc: This lesson discusses the connection between hormones and metabolism. The goal here is to get your hormones in balance, which will regulate your appetite, optimize your BMR, and help you maintain lean body mass. The good news is that to do this we don’t need a deep dive on each and every hormone because what’s good for one hormone is typically good for all of them. Meaning, the recommendations in this lesson help bring your entire body into balance — so you don’t have to deal with each hormone on a case-by-case basis.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Relevance of Macros & Micros
programme.desc: At long last you have arrived at the diet section of this course. And while technically this episode is about food quality, this is where Jillian answers all your questions about popular fad diets. Keto, Carnivore, Paleo, Pegan, Vegan, Vegetarian, Low Fat, Intermittent Fasting, Low Glycemic. Which is best?! Find out what matters most for weight loss.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Role of Exercise in Weight Loss
programme.desc: Finally, the exercise episode! Exercise is the most powerful lever you can pull when it comes to longevity, health, and weight loss. It’s also the number one form of preventative medicine and helps prevent yo-yo dieting. Here Jillian provides clear guidelines for how much and what types of exercises you should be building into your weekly routine.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Why Do We Have Insatiable Hunger?
programme.desc: Hopefully by now you understand that you gain weight because you have eaten more energy than you have burned in your day and stored that energy in your fat cells. But, have you ever wondered WHY you are overeating — i.e. eating more than you are burning? Why do we have such insatiable appetites when our bodies are usually pretty good at staying in balance? And no… it’s not because you have no willpower. This episode digs into where the physiological and psychological hunger is coming from — and how to cope with it.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 3: The 3 Minds NEW
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 3: Align
programme.desc: Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 4: Ease
programme.desc: Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Day 3
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.desc: The media tells you, 'Don’t worry! You’re big and you’re beautiful.' That you are healthy at any size. Nice to hear, but it simply isn’t true. Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 1
programme.desc: This class primarily focuses on increasing the flexibility and suppleness of your cervical spine (the top 7 vertebrae, otherwise known as your neck). We tend to neglect the neck when we practice/train. It has the tendency to be stiff and weak. So, before we practice some strength building mobility work in the next class, let's stretch it out and create some more space in the areas that tend to hold tension. Get your strap out and get ready for some yummy, feel-good stretches that lengthen the tissues of your neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 2
programme.desc: Now that we've stretched out our necks and created some space in this area, let's add some mobility work to the mix. Most of us tend to focus on strengthening bigger muscles and more obvious joints like our shoulders and hips, and our neck tends to get left out and neglected. This class is all about strengthening the neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Boulder Shoulders
programme.desc: The shoulders are the seat of the neck. They influence the way it moves and positions itself in space. When we strengthen and stabilize the shoulders we free up room for better mechanics in the neck. This class will take you on a journey in all the directions the shoulder can mobilize. Let's go.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Flexion Section (Abdominals)
programme.desc: A strong stable core is truly the foundation for proper movement mechanics. Most of us are stuck in spinal extension. Our ribs flare out and our lower back is overly compressed. We need to learn how to access our abdominal muscles through articulating our spine into flexion. Here's a class that will toughen up your abdominal muscles, and teach you how to flex and segment your spine efficiently.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 1: Hormones 101
programme.desc: Your hormones work like a symphony. When every instrument is in tune, they play harmoniously. However, if one instrument is out of tune, or one hormone is out of balance, the entire piece is thrown off. Together, we'll decode your symptoms and work with your body to create hormonal balance. This means clear skin, easier periods, less hot flashes, better sex, and more restful sleep. Yes, it can be that good when your hormones are in check.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 2: Adrenal Glands
programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. In today's lesson, we take a deep dive into the hormones that our adrenal glands produce. We'll start to get an idea of why taking care of and keeping these glands happy is so important.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 5: Estrogen
programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 3: The Thyroid
programme.desc: How common are thyroid conditions? Women are 5 to 8 times more likely than a man to develop thyroid disease. If your thyroid isn't functioning optimally, every single cell in your body will feel it, including your ovaries. A thyroid function that is too high or too low can lead to symptoms that include low heart rate, fatigue, weight loss, and menstrual irregularities.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 9: Detoxification
programme.desc: Did you know that 80,000 toxic chemicals have been released into the environment since the Industrial Revolution? What's worse is that very few have been tested for their long-term impact on human health. Today's session is all about detoxification, the natural process that our liver, kidneys, lungs, lymphatic system, gut, and skin perform daily to get rid of metabolic byproducts that our body produces and toxins that are absorbed from the environment. You'll learn how to avoid toxins and how to address those that you already are carrying due to the nature of the environment, as well as how to optimize your body's ability to detoxify.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 5: Heart Health
programme.desc: Today we learn which tests you should be pursuing for a total view of your heart health and how to synthesize those results systemically.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 7: Hidden Inflammation and Disease
programme.desc: We’ve all experienced inflammation in some form. Today we address how to find this hidden symptom, identify it and its root causes, and stop it in its tracks. There is no optimal health with uncontrolled inflammation.

programme.desc: Don’t demonize fat. It’s actually your friend! Today, you will learn the importance of the quality of the fat you’re consuming, how to select the right kind of monounsaturated fats that nourish your brain, and why it’s important to choose the right cooking oils.

programme.title: Good Mood Food with Jason Wrobel - Mindfulness Practices for Mealtime

If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - 360 Degrees Hips
programme.desc: The hips are the seat of the lower back. If you have low back pain, you will benefit from strengthening and stabilizing the various articulations of the hips. This class will take you on a journey of the hip joint in 360 degrees. When the hips are strong they serve as a foundation for your entire spine. Your spine will move better, function better and feel better when it has the support and stability of the hips.

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Whole Life Assessment

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Energy & Motivation

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Physiology vs Psychology
programme.desc: Today’s session will focus on the different ways we can care for our body, from better sleep hygiene to eating for sustained well-being. Explore how feeling better can lead you to doing more, and feeling better while doing it.

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - Brendon Burchard - The Wellness Masterclass - Presence
programme.desc: The way we relate to our past and future can have major repercussions for how we engage with our present. When we are consumed with worry over how things went or how they will go, it’s impossible to fully engage with the here and now.

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Cultivating Joy
programme.desc: We experience two types of joy. One is momentary, when something funny happens or a nice word is said in passing and we laugh or smile - for a bit, we’re filled with joy. The other is long term and lasting, sustained by gratitude and a life of meaning and purpose. If we’re waiting on joy to enter our life, we’re not living as connected or congruent as we could be.

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Stress
programme.desc: Today’s course walks you through best practices, habits, and mindsets for dealing with stress. Examine your life and identify your stress points, using Brendon’s techniques to release your tension and get back to showing up like you want. Together we’ll prepare for the eventuality of stress by adjusting our relationship with it.

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Purpose
programme.desc: Today we will ask the tough questions necessary to connect you with the unique driving force in your life. The things about purpose is that it’s almost never about isolation. We find and fulfill our purpose by connecting with and serving others.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 2: Befriend
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Yoga For All Day 1: Notice
programme.desc: Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 3: Align
programme.desc: Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 4: Ease
programme.desc: Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

programme.title: Spiritual Makeover with Marianne Williamson - Spiritual Makeover - Part 1
programme.desc: This is not a religious course; rather, it’s a universal system based on love. You think you have many different problems, but you have only one — the illusion of your separation from God, the true nature of reality. We get trapped in illusions (and create our own suffering) when we over-identify with a particular problem or stay stuck in fear-based thinking. This program is here to remind you of a key universal principle: Only love is real.

programme.title: Wild Shots
programme.desc: Tim heads to the Smoky Mountains for an action-packed adventure that’s as sharp as it gets. The journey kicks off at the world-famous Smoky Mountain Knife Works, the largest knife store on the planet, where Tim explores the artistry and precision behind the blades of We Knife. There, he reconnects with shooting legend Kyle Lamb, who shares his thoughts on the craftsmanship that keeps professionals equipped for anything. The action continues at Buds Gun Shop, where Tim joins Kyle once again to complete two of Lamb’s signature courses—the intense “Chaos Drill” and the dynamic “Triple Threat.” Together, they test speed, accuracy, and the mental discipline needed to master the range. But the day wouldn’t be complete without a little backwoods ingenuity. IraqVeteran8888 joins Tim for a bit of unconventional fun—combining creativity, curiosity, and some good old Redneck Science to wrap up an unforgettable episode.

programme.title: Country Ball
programme.desc: In this episode of Country Ball you'll meet Kayleb Wagner who broke the Florida state high-school rushing record held by Alabama alumni Derrick Henry, now a Tennessee Titan, and one of the NFL’s most dominant running backs. Showered with media attention, like most all-time record breakers, Kayleb was now a de facto superstar and destined to be bombarded with scholarship offers. But only one came and was then withdrawn. Why? Because despite his athletic and academic prowess, Kayleb has one arm. Hear Kayleb’s story in his own words, and the words of his amazing mom Sam, where he’s been, what he’s doing now, and most importantly, where he’s going.

programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: The A-Team gets back to work—this time diving into cross-marketing strategies for Advanced Vitality. Over at Hammer Haag, the team discusses launching a gritty new “Micro Dirty Jobs” miniseries to spotlight American manufacturing in action. We’re also introduced to serial entrepreneur Jeff Kline, founder of 1-800-Medigap, who brings a powerhouse presence to the team’s growing roster. Meanwhile, Cindy from Scout & Zoe’s returns for a full brand overhaul with the experts. Newest A-Team member Rudy Mawer steps in with high-level influencer insight and a mission to empower the next generation of entrepreneurs. And finally, Zenith Trek makes bold moves to break into big box retail—with the A-Team guiding the way.

programme.title: All Stars
programme.desc: With a successful mission under their belts, the team of All-Stars can relax and enjoy a day of diving.. or so they thought. The CIA is calling the team back into action for a VBSS mission to secure deadly poisons that are inbound for civilians. If the team thought the previous mission was challenging, this one makes it look like a cake walk. The All-Stars must call upon all their training thus far to make it through this mission, when an unknown element threatens to jeopardize it and them.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The episode opens with contestant Geoff Rempel sharing his powerful backstory and the unique challenges of competing without a military or firearms background—proving that heart, not just experience, earns a place on this team. As the mission begins, the team links up with Pete from Red Cat Drones to run light recon and test critical communication between ground and aerial support. Red Cat brings the best of the best to the skies while the team takes to the ground on bikes, learning to operate under pressure with real-time air-to-ground coordination. But it’s not all strategy and tech—emotions run high as contestant Hayley Taylor opens up about her late father and the personal mission driving her to push harder every day. From aerial coverage to cover stories, it’s not just about who’s strongest... it’s about who’s ready when it counts.

programme.title: Farm Hero
programme.desc: The rain simulator is up and running and the results are shocking. But where do we go from here? How do we fix what’s broken and return to farming with Mother Nature and not against it? Wayne Swanson in Chattanooga Tennessee has some answers. This special episode of Farm Hero highlights the important mission American farmers are on tackling to protect and revitalize our soil… with the help of some Swiss Army Bugs.
